doc.fc491d0bec52cbc3.source:
If this field is absent, this advancement is a root advancement.
Circular references cause a loading failure.
doc.fc491d0bec52cbc3.translation:
如果缺少此字段，则此进度为根进度。
循环引用会导致加载失败。

doc.a0fc4855296ff6cf.source: If present, advancement will be visible in the advancement tabs.
doc.a0fc4855296ff6cf.translation: 如果存在，进度将在进度选项卡中可见。

doc.e69ef5f2c5ff88e9.source: If `requirements` is not defined, all defined criteria will be required.
doc.e69ef5f2c5ff88e9.translation: 如果未定义 `requirements`，则需要所有定义的判据。

doc.b2ef73a10a80fe82.source:
If all criteria are required at once, this may be omitted.

Contains all of the `criteria` keys.

If all of the lists each have at least one criteria met, the advancement is complete (basically AND grouping of OR groups).
doc.b2ef73a10a80fe82.translation:
如果所有判据都是必需条件，则可以省略。

包含所有的 `criteria` 键。

如果所有列表中的每个列表都至少满足一个判据，则进度完成（本质上是 OR 组的 AND 组合）。

doc.1104547c427cc924.source: Provided to the player when this advancement is obtained.
doc.1104547c427cc924.translation: 当玩家获得此进度时提供。

doc.61348407e545b004.source: Defaults to `false`. The vanilla game client only reads this for advancements from the `minecraft` namespace.
doc.61348407e545b004.translation: 默认为 `false`。原版游戏客户端仅对来自 `minecraft` 命名空间的进度读取此项。

doc.99405a30333fa336.source: Many triggers can occur multiple times, however, the reward will only be provided multiple times if the advancement is first revoked, which is often done within the function reward.
doc.99405a30333fa336.translation: 许多触发器可以多次发生，但是，只有在进度首先被撤销的情况下，奖励才会多次提供，这通常在函数奖励中完成。

doc.b2098bc331992cd5.source: Controls the advancement tile frame. Defaults to `task`.
doc.b2098bc331992cd5.translation: 控制进度图标的边框。默认为 `task`。

doc.85424afadb972ad7.source: Whether to show the toast pop up after completing this advancement. Defaults to `true`.
doc.85424afadb972ad7.translation: 完成此进度后是否显示提示弹窗。默认为 `true`。

doc.4e6fac1becf5b823.source: Whether to announce in the chat when this advancement has been completed. Defaults to `true`.
doc.4e6fac1becf5b823.translation: 当此进度完成时是否在聊天中公告。默认为 `true`。

doc.d2b322c5da230440.source:
Whether or not to hide this advancement and all its children from the advancement screen,
until this advancement have been completed.
Has no effect on root advancements themselves, but still affects all their children.
Defaults to `false`.
doc.d2b322c5da230440.translation:
是否在完成此进度之前，从进度界面中隐藏此进度及其所有子进度。
对根进度本身无效，但仍会影响其所有子进度。
默认为 `false`。

doc.037c92bf903fac65.source: Function to run as and at the player. Function tags are not allowed.
doc.037c92bf903fac65.translation: 以玩家身份并在玩家位置运行的函数。不允许使用函数标签。

doc.55d5fc60f0a90998.source: Passes when all of these conditions pass.
doc.55d5fc60f0a90998.translation: 当所有这些条件都通过时通过。

doc.61a5a2f013e7d29b.source: Passes when any of these conditions pass.
doc.61a5a2f013e7d29b.translation: 当其中任何一个条件通过时通过。

doc.eefc6aa333a1c31a.translation: 接受 `0` 与 `1` 之间的值（包含）。

doc.5c8f5f6520a82011.source: Whether to add to the existing count. Defaults to `false`.
doc.5c8f5f6520a82011.translation: 是否添加到现有数量。默认为 `false`。

doc.91916ffcf750203c.source: The entity used to resolve the text components.
doc.91916ffcf750203c.translation: 用于解析文本组件的实体。

doc.09459d3869029316.source: Whether to replace the existing lore list. Defaults to true.
doc.09459d3869029316.translation: 是否替换现有的物品描述列表。默认为 true。

doc.30c14125262716f7.source: Specifies the entity to act as the target `@s` in the JSON text component.
doc.30c14125262716f7.translation: 指定在 JSON 文本组件中充当目标 `@s` 的实体。

doc.24821cccc3778e62.source: Which name component to set. Defaults to `custom_name`.
doc.24821cccc3778e62.translation: 要设置的名称组件。默认为 `custom_name`。

doc.800c5a63e205f8aa.source: Hint: The "Normal" value for this is `200`.

doc.82cdacc6f37994e0.source: Template item that will be used for the pattern.
doc.82cdacc6f37994e0.translation: 将用于图案的模板物品。

doc.0400bf4fbdbb6d59.source: This field is unused by the game.
doc.0400bf4fbdbb6d59.translation: 此字段在游戏中未被使用。

doc.bbb067f3012dc442.source: Ingredient specifying an item to be transformed.
doc.bbb067f3012dc442.translation: 指定将被转换的物品的原料。

doc.398b517eed631278.source: Ingredient specifying an item to be trimmed.
doc.398b517eed631278.translation: 指定要进行纹饰的物品。

doc.ec1a9bf9e7f23f34.source: The trim pattern to apply to the result item.
doc.ec1a9bf9e7f23f34.translation: 应用到结果物品的纹饰图案。

doc.7f779b5b7ef312e3.source:
Optional since 1.21.9. Define it if you want older versions to recognize your pack with
a “made for a newer version” warning message.

Because of backwards compatibility, only the main pack format can
be used here. Minor formats can only be specified in min and max format.
doc.7f779b5b7ef312e3.translation:
自 1.21.9 起可选。如果你希望旧版本在识别你的包时显示“为新版本制作”的警告消息，请定义它。

由于向后兼容性，此处只能使用主包格式。次版本格式只能在 min 和 max 格式中指定。

doc.88bb36b7f1fe4b2e.source:
Must not be specified in case min_format indicates a format version for 1.21.9 and
later.
doc.88bb36b7f1fe4b2e.translation: 如果 min_format 指示的是 1.21.9 及更高版本的格式版本，则不得在此处指定。

doc.bd31a80befc9cc19.source:
The minimun format that is supported. To specify a minor version, use a list of two
integers.
doc.bd31a80befc9cc19.translation: 支持的最小格式。要指定次要版本，请使用包含两个整数的列表。

doc.31a73c0a2f07b817.source:
The maximum format that is supported. To specify a minor version, use a list of two
integers.
doc.31a73c0a2f07b817.translation: 支持的最大格式。要指定次要版本，请使用包含两个整数的列表。

doc.aa31ded1cf4ad30c.source:
Only used by resource pack. \
Adds additional languages to the language menu.
doc.aa31ded1cf4ad30c.translation:
仅由资源包使用。\
向语言菜单中添加额外的语言。

ui.7c96b224b4257ac1.translation: 将 /give 命令转换为战利品表

ui.1b211d021e4adbe2.source: Create data packs to customize your world
ui.1b211d021e4adbe2.translation: 创建数据包来自定义你的世界

ui.9be556f95a017109.source: Browse through and mix all the vanilla sounds
ui.9be556f95a017109.translation: 浏览并混合所有原版声音

ui.a481ff0ba3ace0e8.translation: 可视化显示实体的变换

ui.833ece421d753db6.source: Automatically place all the structure pieces in your world
ui.833ece421d753db6.translation: 在你的世界中自动放置所有结构组件

doc.672cf61e3e97ec2f.source:
When present, overrides the base texture provided by trim pattern. \
The texture is located under `trims/entity/<layer>/`.
doc.672cf61e3e97ec2f.translation:
如果存在，则覆盖纹饰图案提供的基础纹理。
纹理位于 `trims/entity/<layer>/` 下。

doc.c0859aa5e4b263cb.source: When present, overrides the palette texture provided by trim material.
doc.c0859aa5e4b263cb.translation: 如果存在，则覆盖纹饰材质提供的调色板纹理。

doc.510f408c5a1782f6.source: List of ranges to override the size of.
doc.510f408c5a1782f6.translation: 要覆盖尺寸的范围列表。

doc.31c8cc1839a26cb6.source: One condition or an array where at least one condition must apply.
doc.31c8cc1839a26cb6.translation: 一个条件或一个至少包含一个适用条件的数组。

doc.938fac8e095c6e94.source: If set to `true`, the textures are not rotated with the block.
doc.938fac8e095c6e94.translation: 如果设置为 `true`，纹理将不会随方块旋转。

doc.c544d4cd6768b4d0.source: Texture location for this layer, inside `entity/equipment/<layer>/`.
doc.c544d4cd6768b4d0.translation: 此层的纹理位置，位于 `entity/equipment/<layer>/` 内部。

doc.76defeaae369ba02.source:
If specified, this layer will be tinted by the color contained in the `dyed_color` component. \
Items not in the `#dyeable` tag are always considered "not dyed".
doc.76defeaae369ba02.translation:
如果指定，此层将由 `dyed_color` 组件中的颜色着色。 \
不在 `#dyeable` 标签中的物品始终被视为“未染色”。

doc.eeb0bf3e99ec8070.source: If specified, this layer will be tinted by the color contained in the `dyed_color` component.
doc.eeb0bf3e99ec8070.translation: 如果指定，此层将由 `dyed_color` 组件中的颜色着色。

doc.62e09de8a1918434.translation: 码点范围的最小值（包含）。

doc.b800d38c4c7ab881.translation: 码点范围的最大值（包含）。

doc.c12d13d0b680a632.source: Position of left-most column of the glyph.

doc.0bcbec91193f8162.source: Position of right-most column of the glyph.

doc.bc944dad9f927c34.source: ZIP archive containing one or more *.hex files (files in archive with different extensions are ignored).
doc.bc944dad9f927c34.translation: 包含一个或多个 *.hex 文件的 ZIP 归档（忽略归档中具有不同扩展名的文件）。

doc.0e0a15f277aa2119.source:
Texture to use instead of the texture from `kind`.
If present, will ignore the `profile` component.
doc.0e0a15f277aa2119.translation:
代替 `kind` 纹理的纹理。
如果存在，将忽略 `profile` 组件。

doc.3bc7a6d5bd7b32c1.source: Texture to use instead of the texture from `kind`.

doc.f3d2f8df6fdb20ac.source:
Angle in degrees between book cover and book centerline. \
`0.0` for closed, `90.0` for open flat.
doc.f3d2f8df6fdb20ac.translation:
书封面与书中心线之间的角度（单位：度）。\
`0.0` 表示关闭，`90.0` 表示平铺打开。

doc.5f4873a36d552cf9.translation: 要应用的常量着色颜色。

doc.0803b13b548c9978.source:
If false, returns count clamped to `0..max_stack_size`.
If true, returns count divided by the `max_stack_size` component, clamped to `0..1`.
Defaults to true.
doc.0803b13b548c9978.translation:
如果为假，返回限制在 `0..max_stack_size` 的数量。
如果为真，返回数量除以 `max_stack_size` 组件，并限制在 `0..1`。
默认为真。

doc.07906afc246020fa.source: The index of the `flags` list in the `custom_model_data` component. Defaults to 0.
doc.07906afc246020fa.translation: `custom_model_data` 组件中 `flags` 列表的索引。默认为 0。

doc.67c9d52267cda813.source: The index of the `floats` list in the `custom_model_data` component. Defaults to 0.
doc.67c9d52267cda813.translation: `custom_model_data` 组件中 `floats` 列表的索引。默认为 0。

doc.47eca828b1ef48f0.source: The index of the `strings` list in the `custom_model_data` component. Defaults to 0.
doc.47eca828b1ef48f0.translation: `custom_model_data` 组件中 `strings` 列表的索引。默认为 0。

doc.e1fa74d69501863d.source: The index of the `colors` list in the `custom_model_data` component. Defaults to 0.
doc.e1fa74d69501863d.translation: `custom_model_data` 组件中 `colors` 列表的索引。默认为 0。

doc.9cb9f75257d617d8.source: Tint to apply when the `custom_model_data` component is not present, or when it doesn't have a color in the specified index.
doc.9cb9f75257d617d8.translation: 当 `custom_model_data` 组件不存在，或在指定索引中没有颜色时应用的着色。

doc.48b0a760ce29280f.source:
If false, returns value of damage, clamped to `0..max_damage`.
If true, returns value of damage divided by the `max_damage` component, clamped to `0..1`.
Defaults to true.
doc.48b0a760ce29280f.translation:
如果为假，返回限制在 `0..max_damage` 的伤害值。
如果为真，返回伤害值除以 `max_damage` 组件，并限制在 `0..1`。
默认为真。

doc.5ff737544d2b7528.source: Tint to apply when the `dyed_color` component is not present.
doc.5ff737544d2b7528.translation: 当 `dyed_color` 组件不存在时应用的着色。

doc.e09ae1f44e693f66.source: Tint to apply when the `firework_explosion` component is not present.
doc.e09ae1f44e693f66.translation: 当 `firework_explosion` 组件不存在时应用的着色。

doc.b6bd6b1aa72c2b74.source: Whether the default components should be handled as "no component". Defaults to false.
doc.b6bd6b1aa72c2b74.translation: 是否将默认组件视为“无组件”。默认为 false。

doc.cef49c5651333710.source: Controls the animation time for piglin and dragon heads. Defaults to `0`.
doc.cef49c5651333710.translation: 控制猪灵和龙头的动画时间。默认为 `0`。

doc.8be6f04fdc85cc17.source:
Whether the down-and-up animation should be played in first-person view when the item stack is changed.
Defaults to `true`.
doc.8be6f04fdc85cc17.translation:
当物品堆叠发生变化时，是否在第一人称视角中播放下移和上移动画。
默认为 `true`。

doc.726095e9282dd3a7.source:
Whether the item model is allowed to be bigger than its item slot.
Defaults to `false`, which clips the item model in GUI to the item slot size.
The behavior of `true` is **not** officially supported.
doc.726095e9282dd3a7.translation:
是否允许物品模型大于其物品槽位。
默认为 `false`，这会将 GUI 中的物品模型裁剪至物品槽位大小。
`true` 的行为**不**受官方支持。

doc.8f05d23898a686a3.source:
How fast the item moves up and down when swapping items in hotbar.
Defaults to 1.0
doc.8f05d23898a686a3.translation:
在快捷栏切换物品时，物品上下移动的速度。
默认为 1.0

doc.847565861b700a11.source: The keybind ID to check for.
doc.847565861b700a11.translation: 要检查的按键绑定 ID。

doc.7d4d4411583438a9.source:
Format to use for time formatting.
Examples: `yyyy-MM-dd`, `HH:mm:ss`.
doc.7d4d4411583438a9.translation:
用于时间格式化的格式。
示例：`yyyy-MM-dd`，`HH:mm:ss`。

doc.af233d4745af59cd.source:
Defaults to the root locale.
Examples: `en_US`, `cs_AU@numbers=thai;calendar=japanese`.
doc.af233d4745af59cd.translation:
默认为根语言区域。
示例：`en_US`，`cs_AU@numbers=thai;calendar=japanese`。

doc.aded988c97496d5e.source:
Defaults to the timezone set on the client.
Examples: `Europe/Stockholm`, `GMT+0:45`.
doc.aded988c97496d5e.translation:
默认为客户端设置的时区。
示例：`Europe/Stockholm`，`GMT+0:45`。

doc.1fb32b430b75bb19.source: Tint to apply when the `map_color` component is not present.
doc.1fb32b430b75bb19.translation: 当不存在 `map_color` 组件时应用的着色。

doc.6af5cf4f2484cbec.source: Tint to apply when the `potion_contents` component is not present, or it has no effects and no `custom_color` is set.
doc.6af5cf4f2484cbec.translation: 当不存在 `potion_contents` 组件，或者它没有效果且未设置 `custom_color` 时应用的着色。

doc.dd61c4b4d4e63f30.source: Factor to multiply the property value with. Defaults to 1.
doc.dd61c4b4d4e63f30.translation: 用于乘以属性值的因子。默认为 1。

doc.497b333a1daa9e6b.source:
List of ranges. Will select last entry with threshold less or equal to value.
Order does not matter, list will be sorted by threshold in ascending order.
doc.497b333a1daa9e6b.translation:
范围列表。将选择最后一个阈值小于或等于该值的条目。
顺序不重要，列表将按阈值升序排列。

doc.e48693a1a1261d38.source: Item model to render if no entries were less or equal to the value.
doc.e48693a1a1261d38.translation: 如果没有条目小于或等于该值时，渲染的物品模型。

doc.cd660237581f6f75.source: Item model to render if none of the cases matched the value.
doc.cd660237581f6f75.translation: 如果没有任何情况匹配该值时，渲染的物品模型。

doc.544929f496c3671c.translation: 渲染一个特殊的硬编码模型。

doc.ad179e091054edf5.source: Base model, providing transformations, particle texture and GUI light.
doc.ad179e091054edf5.translation: 基础模型，提供变换、粒子纹理和 GUI 光照。

doc.182ece29c418fd97.source:
There is an extra "e" in the field name. See MC-307498. \
Defaults to `ground`.
doc.182ece29c418fd97.translation:
字段名称中有一个额外的“e”。参见 MC-307498。 \
默认为 `ground`。

doc.23e41f8eb8f48466.source: Tint to apply when there is no context entity, entity is not in a team or the team has no color.
doc.23e41f8eb8f48466.translation: 当没有上下文实体、实体不在团队中或团队没有颜色时应用的着色。

doc.7d0de94c3b7b555b.source:
returns remaining item use ticks modulo `period`.
Defaults to 1.
doc.7d0de94c3b7b555b.translation:
返回剩余物品使用刻对 `period` 取模的结果。
默认为 1。

doc.74deb28e84f7de66.source:
If true, returns remaining item use ticks.
If false, returns item use ticks so far.
Defaults to false.
doc.74deb28e84f7de66.translation:
如果为 true，返回剩余物品使用刻。
如果为 false，返回到目前为止的物品使用刻。
默认为 false。

doc.70ee18901cadc7f6.source: Mapping renamed translation keys from old to new keys.
doc.70ee18901cadc7f6.translation: 将重命名的翻译键从旧键映射到新键。

doc.a93e98d5abd621fb.source: Used on compasses to determine the current angle, expressed in a decimal value of less than one.
doc.a93e98d5abd621fb.translation: 用于指南针以确定当前角度，以小于 1 的小数表示。

doc.66b2ea6927add61a.source: Used on shields to determine if currently blocking. If `1`, the player is blocking.
doc.66b2ea6927add61a.translation: 用于盾牌以确定当前是否处于防御状态。如果 `1`，则玩家正在防御。

doc.e66849795df74af1.source: Used on Elytra to determine if broken. If `1`, the Elytra is broken.
doc.e66849795df74af1.translation: 用于鞘翅以确定是否损坏。如果 `1`，则鞘翅已损坏。

doc.4cd25d5b6ad0f11a.source: Used on fishing rods to determine if the fishing rod has been cast. If `1`, the fishing rod has been cast.
doc.4cd25d5b6ad0f11a.translation: 用于钓鱼竿以确定钓鱼竿是否已抛出。如果 `1`，则钓鱼竿已抛出。

doc.88bcd4b1e046c263.source: Used on crossbows to determine if they are charged with any projectile. If `1`, the crossbow is charged.
doc.88bcd4b1e046c263.translation: 用于弩以确定是否已装载任何弹射物。如果 `1`，则弩已上膛。

doc.79b03f42310f4c1a.source: Used on ender pearls and chorus fruit to determine the remaining cooldown, expressed in a decimal value between `0` and `1`.
doc.79b03f42310f4c1a.translation: 用于末影珍珠和紫颂果以确定剩余冷却时间，以 `0` 和 `1` 之间的小数表示。

doc.b2994840eb308891.source:
Used on any item and is compared to the CustomModelData NBT, expressed in an integer value.

The number is still internally converted to float, causing a precision loss for some numbers above 16 million. \
If the value read from the item data is greater than or equal to the value used for the predicate, the predicate is positive.
doc.b2994840eb308891.translation:
用于任何物品，并与以整数表示的 CustomModelData NBT 进行比较。

该数值在内部仍会被转换为 float，导致某些超过 1600 万的数值出现精度损失。 \
如果从物品数据中读取的值大于或等于用于谓词的值，则谓词为正。

doc.7050cd7fd4bf89b2.source:
Replaces trim texture based on armor trim. \
Only the first entry that matches is applied.
doc.7050cd7fd4bf89b2.translation:
根据护甲纹饰替换纹饰贴图。
仅应用第一个匹配的条目。

doc.e7030f6df0b8d161.source:
The position of the first page inside the book. \
`0.0` for leftmost, `1.0` for rightmost.
doc.e7030f6df0b8d161.translation:
书内第一页的位置。\
`0.0` 表示最左侧，`1.0` 表示最右侧。

doc.4c5c25380e24fcbd.source:
The position of the second page inside the book. \
`0.0` for leftmost, `1.0` for rightmost.
doc.4c5c25380e24fcbd.translation:
书内第二页的位置。\
`0.0` 表示最左侧，`1.0` 表示最右侧。

doc.8b3b066d624a8796.source: Whether to oscillate for some time around target before settling. Defaults to true.
doc.8b3b066d624a8796.translation: 是否在稳定前在目标周围摆动一段时间。默认为 true。

doc.838507d59889fc28.source: Used on items with durability to determine the amount of damage, expressed in a decimal value between `0` and `1`.
doc.838507d59889fc28.translation: 用于具有耐久度的物品，以确定损伤量，表示为 `0` 和 `1` 之间的十进制值。

doc.7a5ffb85e7b716ee.source:
Used on items with durability to determine if it is damaged. If 1, the item is damaged. \
Note that if an item has the unbreakable tag, this may be `0` while the item has a non-zero `'damage'` tag.
doc.7a5ffb85e7b716ee.translation:
用于具有耐久度的物品，以确定是否已损坏。如果为 1，则表示物品已损坏。 \
注意，如果物品具有 unbreakable 标签，即使物品具有非零的 `'damage'` 标签，此项也可能为 `0`。

doc.1a9723f7320e6660.source: Used on crossbows. If `1`, the crossbow is charged with a firework rocket.
doc.1a9723f7320e6660.translation: 用于弩。如果为 `1`，则表示弩已用烟花火箭上弦。

doc.f36cba29b7fea8c9.source: Used for honey level on bee nests and beehives.
doc.f36cba29b7fea8c9.translation: 用于蜜蜂巢和蜂巢的蜂蜜等级。

doc.99c4f39d87c5631f.source: Determines the model used by left handed players. It affects the item they see in inventories, along with the item players see them holding or wearing.
doc.99c4f39d87c5631f.translation: 确定左撇子玩家使用的模型。它会影响他们在物品栏中看到的物品，以及其他玩家看到他们手持或穿戴的物品。

doc.384e18176796c706.source: Used for the `level` block state on light items.
doc.384e18176796c706.translation: 用于轻型物品上的 `level` 方块状态。

doc.3460d6ddd3212752.source: Determines the amount a bow or crossbow has been pulled, expressed in a decimal value of less than one.
doc.3460d6ddd3212752.translation: 确定弓或弩被拉开的程度，表示为小于 1 的十进制值。

doc.47a488e13951217f.source: Used on bows and crossbows to determine if the bow is being pulled. If `1`, the bow is currently being pulled.
doc.47a488e13951217f.translation: 用于弓和弩，以确定弓是否正在被拉开。如果为 `1`，则表示弓当前正在被拉开。

doc.522913d6fe64eb8f.source: Used on the trident to determine if the trident is ready to be thrown by the player. If `1`, the trident is ready for fire.
doc.522913d6fe64eb8f.translation: 用于三叉戟，以确定三叉戟是否准备好由玩家投掷。如果为 `1`，则表示三叉戟准备好发射火焰。

doc.1358995e5d18125b.source: Used on clocks to determine the current time, expressed in a decimal value of less than one.
doc.1358995e5d18125b.translation: 用于时钟，以确定当前时间，表示为小于 1 的十进制值。

doc.5024ec2e59d6873c.source: Whether the goat horn is being used.
doc.5024ec2e59d6873c.translation: 山羊角是否正在被使用。

doc.b92fbdc86ccb7eda.source:
Whether the texture should be forced into the translucent render pass. \
Textures without any translucent pixels are not assigned to the translucent pass by default. \
Defaults to `false`.
doc.b92fbdc86ccb7eda.translation:
是否应将纹理强制进入半透明渲染通道。 \
默认情况下，不包含任何半透明像素的纹理不会被分配到半透明通道。 \
默认为 `false`。

doc.857a1ce3507b36e0.source: Points at the location stored in the `lodestone_tracker` component.
doc.857a1ce3507b36e0.translation: 指向 `lodestone_tracker` 组件中存储的位置。

doc.880df7a4ed33202b.source: Points at the last player death location.
doc.880df7a4ed33202b.translation: 指向最后一次玩家死亡的位置。

doc.2525dd4c40ea2982.source:
The component type to check the values of.
If the selected value comes from a registry that the client doesn't have access to,
the entry will be silently ignored.
doc.2525dd4c40ea2982.translation:
要检查值的组件类型。
如果选定的值来自客户端无法访问的注册表，
该条目将被静默忽略。

doc.c60bae41a277f456.source: Unused by the game, but good to set in practice.
doc.c60bae41a277f456.translation: 游戏不使用，但在实践中建议设置。

doc.e5a9e74f843793a7.source:
If `true`, target will be persistent across frames. Defaults to `false`.
The contents of the target will be cleared when the screen is resized.
doc.e5a9e74f843793a7.translation:
如果 `true`，目标将在帧间持久化。默认为 `false`。
当屏幕尺寸改变时，目标内容将被清除。

doc.da7afc9b4195feef.source: Target will be filled with this color when created or cleared. Defaults to `0`.
doc.da7afc9b4195feef.translation: 创建或清除时，目标将填充此颜色。默认为 `0`。

doc.2ebf42d39cbb4f3f.source: List of uniform values in this block. The order must match the order in the shader file.
doc.2ebf42d39cbb4f3f.translation: 此块中的统一变量值列表。顺序必须与着色器文件中的顺序一致。

doc.25c88a6833d92c0e.source: Values that will be injected as `#define <key> <value>` at the top of the file.
doc.25c88a6833d92c0e.translation: 将作为 `#define <key> <value>` 注入到文件顶部的数值。

doc.37a28f7d3823e3dc.source: Flags that will be injected as `#define <key>` at the top of the file.
doc.37a28f7d3823e3dc.translation: 将作为 `#define <key>` 注入到文件顶部的标志。

doc.d0c3a342f4a8f920.source: Defines GLSL directives to be injected into the shader source.
doc.d0c3a342f4a8f920.translation: 定义将注入到着色器源码中的 GLSL 指令。

doc.cd85fa8a3b825728.source: Changes how `name` is interpreted. Defaults to `file`.
doc.cd85fa8a3b825728.translation: 更改 `name` 的解析方式。默认为 `file`。

doc.f43ecd1995f5f8b4.source: Chance that this sound is selected to play. Defaults to 1.
doc.f43ecd1995f5f8b4.translation: 选择播放此声音的概率。默认为 1。

doc.4860903f8c489aa7.source: Whether the sound should be loaded when loading the pack instead of when the sound is played. Used by the underwater ambience. Defaults to false.
doc.4860903f8c489aa7.translation: 是否在加载资源包时而非播放声音时加载该声音。用于水下环境音。默认为 false。

doc.25f1a02b88ead42b.source:
If true it will be streamed from its file. Sounds longer than a few seconds should enable this to avoid lag. Defaults to false.
When false many instances of the sound can be ran at the same time. When true only allows 4 instances (of that type) can be played.
doc.25f1a02b88ead42b.translation:
如果为 true，将从其文件流式传输。长度超过几秒的声音应启用此项以避免卡顿。默认为 false。
当为 false 时，可以同时运行多个该声音的实例。当为 true 时，仅允许播放 4 个（该类型的）实例。

doc.cd9578d53c9918d8.source: Modify sound reduction rate based on distance. Defaults to 16.
doc.cd9578d53c9918d8.translation: 根据距离修改声音衰减率。默认为 16。

doc.5e28a64ecc96f2ab.source: The sound files this sound event uses. One sound is randomly selected to play when the event is triggered. Defaults to assumed path.
doc.5e28a64ecc96f2ab.translation: 此声音事件使用的声音文件。触发事件时将随机选择一个声音播放。默认为假设路径。

doc.14c020adb99fc1a5.source:
If true the sounds listed should replace the ones listed in the minecraft sounds.json for this sound event.
False if the sounds listed should be added. If undefined. Defaults to false.
doc.14c020adb99fc1a5.translation:
如果为 true，则列出的声音应替换此声音事件中 sounds.json 所列出的声音。
如果为 False，则列出的声音将被添加。如果未定义，则默认为 false。

doc.cfafcc357098961b.source: Translated as the subtitle when Show Subtitles is enabled. Section sign formatting codes are supported.
doc.cfafcc357098961b.translation: 当启用“显示字幕”时，将作为字幕翻译。支持区块告示牌格式代码。

doc.e25e0c36c4d34591.source: Causes the texture to blur when viewed from close up. Defaults to false.
doc.e25e0c36c4d34591.translation: 导致纹理在近距离查看时变模糊。默认为 false。

doc.bd153c33410e6f94.source: Causes the texture to stretch instead of tiling in cases where it otherwise would, such as on the shadow. Defaults to false.
doc.bd153c33410e6f94.translation: 在原本会平铺的情况下（例如在阴影上），导致纹理拉伸而非平铺。默认为 false。

doc.e66c672e3ba6d9b9.source:
The alpha bias for cutout textures. \
Positive values make the texture more opaque at distance.
Negative values make the texture more transparent at distance. \
Defaults to 0.0
doc.e66c672e3ba6d9b9.translation:
用于切割纹理的 alpha 偏差。 \
正值使纹理在远距离处更不透明。\n负值使纹理在远距离处更透明。 \
默认为 0.0

doc.e97aac288c22f340.source: Configures how the GUI texture should be scaled. Defaults to `stretch`.
doc.e97aac288c22f340.translation: 配置 GUI 纹理的缩放方式。默认为 `stretch`。

doc.dd2bbb162df4243b.source: If true, additional frames will be generated between frames with a frame time greater than 1 between them. Defaults to false.
doc.dd2bbb162df4243b.translation: 如果为 true，将在帧间隔大于 1 的帧之间生成额外的帧。默认为 false。

doc.9b2d743b0c2fede8.source: The width of the tile, as a direct ratio rather than in pixels. Can be used by resource packs to have frames that are not perfect squares.
doc.9b2d743b0c2fede8.translation: 瓷砖宽度，作为直接比例而非像素。资源包可用于创建非正方形的帧。

doc.0c4be3a2f08394c9.source: The height of the tile, as a direct ratio rather than in pixels. Can be used by resource packs to have frames that are not perfect squares.
doc.0c4be3a2f08394c9.translation: 瓷砖高度，作为直接比例而非像素。资源包可用于创建非正方形的帧。

doc.9544af1cff33fdbc.source: Fancy spiked border (used for the kill all mobs advancement).
doc.9544af1cff33fdbc.translation: 华丽尖刺边界（用于“击败所有生物”进度）。

doc.402496370a811958.source: Rounded border (used for the full beacon advancement).
doc.402496370a811958.translation: 圆角边界（用于“完整信标”进度）。

doc.1816dc4792191d2f.source: Match exact data component values on the block entity.
doc.1816dc4792191d2f.translation: 匹配方块实体上的精确数据组件值。

doc.1540bc7a9a73db5a.source: Test data component values on the block entity.
doc.1540bc7a9a73db5a.translation: 测试方块实体上的数据组件值。

doc.ea56cd41ac7c4382.source: Amount of incoming damage before damage reduction.
doc.ea56cd41ac7c4382.translation: 伤害衰减前的入站伤害量。

doc.e134d665bbec9f90.source: Amount of incoming damage after damage reduction.
doc.e134d665bbec9f90.translation: 伤害衰减后的入站伤害量。

doc.3f8bde80f24b6d9d.source: Whether the damage was successfully blocked.

doc.9c02bfe486b44099.source: Source of the damage (eg: a skeleton shooting an arrow or player igniting tnt).
doc.9c02bfe486b44099.translation: 伤害来源（例如：骷髅射出箭矢或玩家点燃 TNT）。

doc.7be1cc5a57da7876.source: Damage type tags that the damage type is in.
doc.7be1cc5a57da7876.translation: 该伤害类型所属的伤害类型标签。

doc.c59ee2df8639fa1e.source: Direct entity responsible for the damage (eg: the arrow or tnt).
doc.c59ee2df8639fa1e.translation: 负责造成伤害的直接实体（例如：箭矢或 TNT）。

doc.38d50b10c4c2034c.source: Damage is direct when its direct and source entities are the same.
doc.38d50b10c4c2034c.translation: 当直接实体与来源实体相同时，伤害为直接伤害。

doc.38ad460cfe5318f2.source: Whether the damage is expected to have or not have the tag.
doc.38ad460cfe5318f2.translation: 伤害是否预期拥有或不拥有该标签。

doc.155b45add8d076b4.source: List of sprite sources which can add or remove sprite textures to this atlas.
doc.155b45add8d076b4.translation: 可向此图集添加或移除精灵贴图的精灵资源列表。

doc.7d4517782ff1782f.source: Directory of texture locations to include, relative to the `textures` folder, not including the trailing `/`.
doc.7d4517782ff1782f.translation: 包含的纹理位置目录，相对于 `textures` 文件夹，不包括末尾的 `/`。

doc.1903d53fc0e6f376.source: The sprite name prefix, usually ending with `/`.
doc.1903d53fc0e6f376.translation: 精灵名称前缀，通常以 `/` 结尾。

doc.b9182390656c2fac.source: Pattern to remove sprite identifiers already in the atlas. The order of sprite sources is important.
doc.b9182390656c2fac.translation: 移除已在图集中的精灵标识符的模式。精灵资源的顺序很重要。

doc.2d93d9210533ecf6.source:
Value to use when joining the texture and permutation names to produce the sprite name.
Defaults to `_`.
doc.2d93d9210533ecf6.translation:
用于连接纹理和排列组合名称以生成精灵名称的值。
默认为 `_`。

doc.11f4dc1d9a7e967d.source: A single texture location of the source.
doc.11f4dc1d9a7e967d.translation: 资源的一个单一纹理位置。

doc.74a396ccfce420fc.source:
The identifier of the sprite that can referenced.
If not specified, matches `resource`.
doc.74a396ccfce420fc.translation:
可引用的精灵标识符。
如果未指定，则匹配 `resource`。

doc.963e181e0200401c.source: If set to the resource width, regions will use pixel coordinates.
doc.963e181e0200401c.translation: 如果设置为资源宽度，区域将使用像素坐标。

doc.2578adcfbc5d37b8.source: If set to the resource height, regions will use pixel coordinates.
doc.2578adcfbc5d37b8.translation: 如果设置为资源高度，区域将使用像素坐标。

doc.2caa5df5d4f3767a.source:
Whether this layer texture should be overridden by the player's custom elytra texture. \
Defaults to `false`.
doc.2caa5df5d4f3767a.translation:
该层纹理是否应被玩家自定义的鞘翅纹理覆盖。 \
默认为 `false`。

doc.5863f2b0936c642e.source:
If the item is not dyed, this color is used instead. \
If not specified and the item is not dyed, this layer will be hidden.
doc.5863f2b0936c642e.translation:
如果物品未染色，则使用此颜色。 \
如果未指定且物品未染色，则此层将被隐藏。

doc.64d3bc7617fe3f57.source: List of layers for each model layer type.
doc.64d3bc7617fe3f57.translation: 每个模型层类型的层列表。

doc.fc0f80cc8f35d23a.source: Sets the default time for each frame in increments of one game tick. Defaults to 1.
doc.fc0f80cc8f35d23a.translation: 以一个游戏刻为增量设置每帧的默认时间。默认为 1。

doc.2fe0dd6d83481e3e.source: Defaults to displaying all the frames from top to bottom.
doc.2fe0dd6d83481e3e.translation: 默认为从上到下显示所有帧。

doc.00f6b66625d7ab85.source: A number corresponding to position of a frame from the top, with the top frame being 0.
doc.00f6b66625d7ab85.translation: 对应从顶部开始的帧位置的数字，顶部帧为 0。

doc.d0449cb071b7ea54.source: The time in ticks to show this frame, overriding `frametime` above.
doc.d0449cb071b7ea54.translation: 显示此帧的刻数，覆盖上述的 `frametime`。

doc.d45ea5f3971a1ee0.source:
Determines whether the villager's 'profession' hat layer should allow the 'type' hat layer to render or not. \
Defaults to `none`.
doc.d45ea5f3971a1ee0.translation:
决定村民的“职业”帽子层是否允许“类型”帽子层渲染。 \
默认为 `none`。

doc.b36b78780a9707cd.source: Must have at least one of the listed tags.
doc.b36b78780a9707cd.translation: 必须至少拥有其中一个列出的标签。

doc.4afefdcf82a0b905.source: Must have all the listed tags.
doc.4afefdcf82a0b905.translation: 必须拥有所有列出的标签。

doc.e678da09f128a970.source: Must have none of the listed tags.
doc.e678da09f128a970.translation: 不能拥有任何列出的标签。

doc.21ee608d1e111dfb.translation: 使用以下内容计算：`max(sky-darkening, block)`。

doc.ca5528c749712917.source: Whether the block is above (5 blocks or less) a campfire or soul campfire.
doc.ca5528c749712917.translation: 方块是否位于营火或灵魂营火上方（5个方块或更少）。

doc.1006d42b95dacde1.source: Whether the location has the maximum possible level of sky light
doc.1006d42b95dacde1.translation: 该位置是否具有最大可能的天空光照等级

doc.fac4cf4558af07b4.source: Entity that a mob's AI/aggro is targeting.
doc.fac4cf4558af07b4.translation: 生物 AI/仇恨的目标实体。

doc.ab05d05cf2d1d6e8.source: True every `n` ticks of an entity's lifetime.
doc.ab05d05cf2d1d6e8.translation: 在实体生命周期的每 `n` 刻为真。

doc.7c2903065d27ab0e.source: Whether the block at most 0.5 blocks below the entity is present which can affect its movement.
doc.7c2903065d27ab0e.translation: 实体下方最多 0.5 个方块处是否存在可能影响其移动的方块。

doc.e417f379710238f8.source: Match exact data component values on the entity.
doc.e417f379710238f8.translation: 匹配实体上的精确数据组件值。

doc.8df6578400a3924c.source: Test data component values on the entity.
doc.8df6578400a3924c.translation: 测试实体上的数据组件值。

doc.057d01096c9fd89b.source: Checks the movement keys of the player.

doc.f030f1b7e4dc783d.source: Where the player started to travel.

doc.5c15d13b72db2315.source: Where in the Overworld the player was when they travelled to the Nether.
doc.5c15d13b72db2315.translation: 玩家前往下界时在主世界的具体位置。

doc.62bcb9d39986eada.source: How far the player now is from the coordinate they started at in the Overworld before travelling.
doc.62bcb9d39986eada.translation: 玩家当前距离旅行前在主世界的起始坐标的距离。

doc.19678ce0686d2890.source: Where in the Nether the player was when they travelled back to the Overworld.
doc.19678ce0686d2890.translation: 玩家返回主世界时在下界的具体位置。

doc.85d486f17ea0dfa2.source:
Predicate context: Advancement Entity. \
Entity may not exist.
doc.85d486f17ea0dfa2.translation:
谓词上下文：进度实体。\
实体可能不存在。

doc.1fcdd5842acdf7a7.source:
Predicate context: Advancement Entity. \
Entity that was pulled.
Or the hook itself if no entity was hooked.
doc.1fcdd5842acdf7a7.translation:
谓词上下文：进度实体。\
被拉出的实体。
或者如果没有实体被钩住，则是钩子本身。

doc.a0164ae4f623e1c0.source: Amount of slots that are a full stack.

doc.017982b0d3c3788d.source: Change in durability (negative numbers are used to indicate a decrease in durability).
doc.017982b0d3c3788d.translation: 耐久度变化（负数表示耐久度减少）。

doc.02825edb906a12ee.source: The item before its durability changed.

doc.0627c0c03ea67dd9.source: How many different types of entities were killed.
doc.0627c0c03ea67dd9.translation: 击杀了多少种不同类型的实体。

doc.fd006d3f2e694291.source: The weapon item that was used to fire the arrow.
doc.fd006d3f2e694291.translation: 用于发射箭矢的武器物品。

doc.e7a59dac96561705.source:
Predicate context: Advancement Entity. \
Evaluates to true if every predicate in the list matches some victims.
doc.e7a59dac96561705.translation:
谓词上下文：进度实体。 \
如果列表中每个谓词都匹配某些受害者，则评估为 true。

doc.dfd5605c30ec06d1.source:
Predicate context: Advancement Entity. \
Evaluates to false if no entities are nearby.
doc.dfd5605c30ec06d1.translation:
谓词上下文：进度实体。 \
如果没有实体在附近，则评估为 false。

doc.d77d3245525897ff.source: Number of bees that were inside the bee nest/beehive before it was broken.
doc.d77d3245525897ff.translation: 蜂巢/蜂箱被破坏前内部的蜂的数量。

doc.2e244739d2665df1.source: Item used to break the block.

doc.9af14dd2b73037f6.source:
Item that was purchased. \
`count` tag checks the item count from one trade, not the total amount traded for.
doc.9af14dd2b73037f6.translation:
购买的物品。 \
`count` 标签检查单次交易中的物品数量，而非交易的总量。

doc.fbc2338bf4541707.source:
Only has effect on stackable items. \
Defaults to `true`.
doc.fbc2338bf4541707.translation:
仅对可堆叠物品有效。\
默认为 `true`。

doc.95cdb17280783797.source:
Only has effect on unstackable items. \
Defauls to 1.
doc.95cdb17280783797.translation:
仅对不可堆叠物品有效。\
默认为 1。

doc.5c765d91208abaa0.source: If the original block and the transformed block are both copper chests of any kind, the transform applies to the other half of the double chest.
doc.5c765d91208abaa0.translation: 如果原始方块和转换后的方块均为任何类型的铜箱子，则转换将应用于双箱子的另一半。

doc.1e81e51082e655c4.source: A single tick of burning hurt sound.

doc.00c221ecf3fad382.translation: 如果是由非玩家的生物实体造成的，则随难度缩放。

The message id used for deaths caused by this damage type.

用于此伤害类型导致的死亡的消息 ID。
与 `death_message_type` 的结果结合形成翻译键。

doc.5a939124d73ea315.source: Amount of hunger exhaustion to cause.

doc.96be93bd3e7774a9.translation: 是否随难度等级缩放伤害。

doc.fdfd7e8956062a6f.translation: 控制对玩家造成伤害时的表现形式。默认为 `hurt`。

doc.3abd951fecef6e93.source:
Controls if special death message variants are used. Defaults to `default`.

For more info see: https://minecraft.wiki/w/Damage_type#Death_messages
doc.3abd951fecef6e93.translation:
控制是否使用特殊的死亡消息变体。默认为 `default`。

更多信息请参阅：https://minecraft.wiki/w/Damage_type#Death_messages

doc.bf94ecf63f4c6ca7.source:
Whether the dialog should pause the game in single-player mode.
Defaults to `true`.
doc.bf94ecf63f4c6ca7.translation:
对话是否应在单人模式下暂停游戏。
默认为 `true`。

Whether the dialog should pause the game in single-player mode.
Defaults to `true`.

The currently selected `after_action` only supports the value `false`
doc.b1222d8d4c86fc26.translation:
对话是否应在单人模式下暂停游戏。
默认为 `true`。

当前选择的 `after_action` 仅支持 `false` 值

doc.fc55c1d393cc64bd.source:
ID of a custom action.
Has no functionality on vanilla servers.
doc.fc55c1d393cc64bd.translation:
自定义动作 ID。
在原版服务器上没有功能。

doc.8749877348c4b1be.source: Static fields added in addition to the fields generated by input.
doc.8749877348c4b1be.translation: 除输入生成的字段外额外添加的静态字段。

A macro template to be interpred as a command.
Special characters (including both `'` and `"`) from text input will be escaped to fit in SNBT literal.
doc.614e3f5610ea9354.translation:
作为命令进行解释的宏模板。
文本输入中的特殊字符（包括 `'` 和 `"`）将被转义以符合 SNBT 字面量要求。

doc.27ea98962b2c2107.source:
Closes the dialog.
Returns to the previous non-dialog screen, if any.
doc.27ea98962b2c2107.translation:
关闭对话。
返回到之前的非对话界面（如有）。

doc.b32caa154e94f9e7.source:
Does nothing.
Only available if `pause` is set to `false`.
doc.b32caa154e94f9e7.translation:
无任何操作。
仅在 `pause` 设置为 `false` 时可用。

doc.92183e2446921bad.source:
Replaces the dialog with a "Waiting for Response" screen.
The waiting screen unpauses the game in single-player mode.
doc.92183e2446921bad.translation:
用“等待响应”界面替换对话。
等待界面将在单人模式下取消游戏暂停。

doc.5e53fcb99d1e2b7c.source: The description text rendered to the right of item.
doc.5e53fcb99d1e2b7c.translation: 渲染在物品右侧的描述文本。

doc.adc9f4acc5b26517.source:
Whether count and damage bar are rendered over the item.
Defaults to `true`.
doc.adc9f4acc5b26517.translation:
是否在物品上方渲染数量和伤害条。
默认为 `true`。

doc.d757d1fef05a398b.source: Horizontal distance between the player and the stronghold.
doc.d757d1fef05a398b.translation: 玩家与要塞之间的水平距离。

doc.b483a2703d9413ae.source: Tier of the updated beacon base.
doc.b483a2703d9413ae.translation: 更新后的信标基座等级。

doc.498f866aea88a6c3.source: Item that was used to place the block before the item was consumed.
doc.498f866aea88a6c3.translation: 在物品消耗前用于放置方块的物品。

doc.f86170973a14081b.source: If the provider returns no result, the next transformer will be attempted.
doc.f86170973a14081b.translation: 如果提供者未返回结果，将尝试下一个转换器。

doc.d6dfb3e3ea597afe.source:
If a disallowed face is interacted with, the next transformer will be attempted. \
Defaults to empty (allowing all faces).
doc.d6dfb3e3ea597afe.translation:
如果与禁止的面交互，将尝试下一个转换器。 \
默认为空（允许所有面）。

doc.3dc263cf82275fad.source:
The loot to drop on a successful transformation. \
Defaults to drop nothing.
doc.3dc263cf82275fad.translation:
转换成功时掉落的战利品。 \
默认为不掉落任何物品。

doc.06122cad052d4004.source:
Where the `loot` should drop. \
Defaults to `from_middle`.
doc.06122cad052d4004.translation:
`loot` 应掉落的位置。 \
默认为 `from_middle`。

doc.4d781bd19e2ddbe8.source:
How nearby blocks are affected by the transformation. \
Defaults to `single_block`.
doc.4d781bd19e2ddbe8.translation:
附近方块受转换影响的方式。 \
默认为 `single_block`。

doc.0f6a1da84fe5c37e.source:
Whether the transformed block should update based on neighboring blocks. \
Defaults to `true`.
doc.0f6a1da84fe5c37e.translation:
转换后的方块是否应根据相邻方块进行更新。 \
默认为 `true`。

doc.f2bf8ea5ae516edd.source:
Whether this option is the initial value.
Only one option can have this field set to `true`.
doc.f2bf8ea5ae516edd.translation:
此选项是否为初始值。
只能有一个选项将此字段设置为 `true`。

doc.ef0c5902a620caa7.source: Label displayed to the left of control.

doc.ccf7160955d88538.source:
Initial contents of the text input.
Defaults to `""` (empty string).
doc.ccf7160955d88538.translation:
文本输入的初始内容。
默认为 `""`（空字符串）。

doc.6862d8324bfdf3c6.source:
Maximum length of input
Defaults to 32.
doc.6862d8324bfdf3c6.translation:
输入的最大长度
默认为 32。

doc.203461082ee41195.source: If present, allows users to input multiple lines.
doc.203461082ee41195.translation: 如果存在，允许用户输入多行。

doc.c738a5bee8a2a1a3.source:
The button in footer.
The action is also used for ESC-triggered exit.
doc.c738a5bee8a2a1a3.translation:
页脚中的按钮。
该操作也用于 ESC 触发的退出。

doc.101b51542ab3e962.source:
The number of columns.
Defaults to 2.

doc.be8bf5f58182dcc5.source:
The only action in footer.
Defaults to `gui.ok` label with no action or tooltip.
doc.be8bf5f58182dcc5.translation:
页脚中唯一的操作。
默认为无操作或工具提示的 `gui.ok` 标签。

doc.ed245ba70cc8014f.source:
Amount of ammunition being used up. \
`0` has a side effect of applying `intangible_projectile` component to the projectile item.
doc.ed245ba70cc8014f.translation:
消耗的弹药数量。 \
`0` 会对弹射物物品应用 `intangible_projectile` 组件的副作用。

doc.3e0416f3f1b1400d.source: Determines armor effectiveness; `0.0` for no effect, `1.0` for full effect.
doc.3e0416f3f1b1400d.translation: 决定护甲效果；`0.0` 无效果，`1.0` 全效果。

doc.0f092ac6634c779a.source:
Whether item tooltip shows up when the item is hovered.
Defaults to `true`.
doc.0f092ac6634c779a.translation:
当鼠标悬停在物品上时是否显示物品工具提示。
默认为 `true`。

doc.f335c6665d6332f3.source:
Width of the item.
Defaults to 16.

doc.f13035a1d6531aed.source:
Height of the item.
Defaults to 16.

doc.40c69e31402a3511.source:
A multiline label.
Click events in the text trigger `after_action` like any other action.
doc.40c69e31402a3511.translation:
多行标签。
文本中的点击事件将像其他操作一样触发 `after_action`。

doc.030e05c082dfb5b9.source:
Maximum width of message.
Defaults to 200.
doc.030e05c082dfb5b9.translation:
消息的最大宽度。
默认为 200。

doc.4b10b11b55838034.source:
Width of the button.
Defaults to 150.

doc.0c5e3e24dff2d2f7.source: If not present, clicking button will simply close dialog without any action.
doc.0c5e3e24dff2d2f7.translation: 若不存在，点击按钮将仅关闭对话框而没有任何操作。

doc.aa81fd8c87ecee23.source:
Width of buttons in the list.
Defaults to 150.
doc.aa81fd8c87ecee23.translation:
列表中按钮的宽度。
默认为 150。

doc.1b260fec005998bf.source: This action is also used for ESC-triggered exit.
doc.1b260fec005998bf.translation: 此操作也用于触发 ESC 键退出。

doc.21f4c159006099ae.source:
Name to be used for a button leading to this dialog.
If not present, `title` will be used instead.
doc.21f4c159006099ae.translation:
指向此对话的按钮名称。
若未提供，将使用 `title` 代替。

doc.ef11d107f2806cb4.source:
Whether the dialog can be closed with ESC key.
Defaults to `true`.
doc.ef11d107f2806cb4.translation:
对话是否可以按 ESC 键关闭。
默认为 `true`。

doc.a848c3a1b3a742ff.source: Dummy value; this is a boolean effect.
doc.a848c3a1b3a742ff.translation: 占位值；这是一个布尔效果。

Damage reduction factor. \
Provides `factor * 4%` of damage reduction, capped at 80%.
doc.f9e259535873fa21.translation:
伤害降低系数。\
提供 `factor * 4%` 的伤害降低，上限为 80%。

doc.403455091c4bb19f.source:
Chance between `0.0` and `1.0` of an equipped piece dropping. \
If the drop chance on mob is 0, the chance will not be affected by this effect.
doc.403455091c4bb19f.translation:
装备掉落的概率在 `0.0` 和 `1.0` 之间。\
如果生物的掉落概率为 0，则该概率不会受此效果影响。

doc.629aa328998d816a.source: Which subject needs to be enchanted for the effect to apply.
doc.629aa328998d816a.translation: 效果生效时需要附魔的主体。

doc.1eb58c8cc657df53.source:
Predicate context: Entity Parameters.

`this` is the player fishing.
doc.1eb58c8cc657df53.translation:
谓词上下文：实体参数。

`this` 是正在钓鱼的玩家。

doc.0238af5bbfe1d429.source: Time reduction in seconds (higher values mean less time until a fish bites).
doc.0238af5bbfe1d429.translation: 秒数缩减（数值越高，鱼上钩所需时间越短）。

doc.ae984d231a214cad.source:
Predicate context: Entity Parameters.

`this` is the entity hitting the Block, unless during a projectile attack, then, `this` is the projectile.
doc.ae984d231a214cad.translation:
谓词上下文：实体参数。

`this` 是击中方块的实体，除非在弹射物攻击期间，此时 `this` 为弹射物。

doc.bc4494fc5d862dc8.source: On the entity hitting the Block

doc.8a8677e53cc22125.source: Amount of damage being dealt to the item.

doc.d67b57553c5f4c37.source:
Predicate context: Entity Parameters.

`this` is the killed mob.
doc.d67b57553c5f4c37.translation:
谓词上下文：实体参数。

`this` 是被杀死的生物。

doc.0465a7613a264f65.source:
Examples:
- A Fire Aspect Enchant would specify that when the attacker is enchanted, the `ignite` effect is applied, and the affected party is the victim.
- Thorns would specify that when the victim is enchanted, the `damage_entity` effect is applied, and the affected party is the attacker.
doc.0465a7613a264f65.translation:
示例：
- 火焰附加魔咒将指定当攻击者附魔时，应用 `ignite` 效果，且受影响方为受害者。
- 荆棘将指定当受害者附魔时，应用 `damage_entity` 效果，且受影响方为攻击者。

doc.54b58dead2caff1c.source: When set to `attacker`, this effect only works on enchanted weapon, regardless of the `slots` field.
doc.54b58dead2caff1c.translation: 当设置为 `attacker` 时，无论 `slots` 字段如何，此效果仅对附魔武器有效。

doc.02311c6f7d5ab40a.source: If multiple mob effects are specified, a random effect is selected.
doc.02311c6f7d5ab40a.translation: 如果指定了多种生物效果，将随机选择一种效果。

doc.07cde250debadd7b.source:
Used when equipping and unequipping the item to identify which modifier to add or remove from the entity.

Postfixed with the slot name when the enchanted item is equipped.
doc.07cde250debadd7b.translation:
用于在装备和卸下物品时识别要从实体中添加或移除哪些修改。

当装备附魔物品时，会以槽位名称作为后缀。

doc.86131162b0f85bb4.source: No item drops or special behavior.
doc.86131162b0f85bb4.translation: 不掉落物品或无特殊行为。

doc.2f8e36d22a292714.source: Drops items as if a block caused the explosion; `blockExplosionDropDecay` game rule applies.
doc.2f8e36d22a292714.translation: 像方块引起爆炸一样掉落物品；`blockExplosionDropDecay` 游戏规则适用。

doc.549b49921ef3d1bb.source: Drops items as if a block caused the explosion; `block_explosion_drop_decay` game rule applies.
doc.549b49921ef3d1bb.translation: 像方块引起爆炸一样掉落物品；`block_explosion_drop_decay` 游戏规则适用。

doc.b040c016d6914e31.source: Drops items as if a mob caused the explosion; `mobExplosionDropDecay` game rule applies.
doc.b040c016d6914e31.translation: 像生物引起爆炸一样掉落物品；`mobExplosionDropDecay` 游戏规则适用。

doc.506758e0e9744d41.source: Drops items as if a mob caused the explosion; `mob_explosion_drop_decay` game rule applies.
doc.506758e0e9744d41.translation: 像生物引起爆炸一样掉落物品；`mob_explosion_drop_decay` 游戏规则适用。

doc.04e7c07fedd8e680.source: Drops items as if TNT caused the explosion; `tntExplosionDropDecay` game rule applies.
doc.04e7c07fedd8e680.translation: 像 TNT 引起爆炸一样掉落物品；`tntExplosionDropDecay` 游戏规则适用。

doc.cf75e38bb8866a1b.source: Drops items as if TNT caused the explosion; `tnt_explosion_drop_decay` game rule applies.
doc.cf75e38bb8866a1b.translation: 像 TNT 引起爆炸一样掉落物品；`tnt_explosion_drop_decay` 游戏规则适用。

doc.58f3e953e68e54cd.source:
Damage to apply to the enchanted item. Negative values will repair the item.
The change is not applied to items held by players in creative mode.
doc.58f3e953e68e54cd.translation:
应用到附魔物品的伤害。负值将修复物品。
该变化不应用于创造模式玩家持有的物品。

doc.08b860837c6799b4.source: Amount of damage is randomized within the given min/max span.
doc.08b860837c6799b4.translation: 伤害量在给定的最小值/最大值范围内随机生成。

doc.b391b62cc07c8765.source:
Damage to apply to the enchanted item.
The damage is not applied to items held by players in creative mode.
doc.b391b62cc07c8765.translation:
应用于附魔物品的伤害。
伤害不会应用于创造模式下玩家持有的物品。

doc.f0afff0d6346d727.source: Whether the explosion should be attributed to the user of the enchanted tool.
doc.f0afff0d6346d727.translation: 爆炸是否应归属于附魔工具的使用者。

doc.129acef16e94fb1d.source: If omitted, no damage is dealt by the explosion.
doc.129acef16e94fb1d.translation: 若省略，爆炸不会造成伤害。

doc.53289295df057649.source: List of Blocks or hash-prefixed Block Tag specifying which blocks fully block the explosion.
doc.53289295df057649.translation: 指定完全阻挡爆炸的方块或带哈希前缀的方块标签列表。

doc.50e45ae22ffc7d83.source: If omitted, constant value `1` is applied.

doc.93de60085f236267.source: Relative coordinates to offset the explosion by. Defaults to `[0, 0, 0]`.
doc.93de60085f236267.translation: 用于偏移爆炸的相对坐标。默认为 `[0, 0, 0]`。

doc.970e13f54a918af2.source: Whether fire is placed within the explosion radius.
doc.970e13f54a918af2.translation: 爆炸半径内是否生成火焰。

doc.ce232a7f89673bf5.source: Whether the explosion has special effects on blocks.
doc.ce232a7f89673bf5.translation: 爆炸对方块是否有特殊效果。

doc.791fab8da6c3d7bd.source: Defaults to 1.0. Scaling of the distance between the center of the explosion and the block
doc.791fab8da6c3d7bd.translation: 默认为 1.0。爆炸中心与方块之间距离的缩放比例

doc.039a2c6c5274e5c3.source: Defaults to 1.0. Scaling of the speed of the particle
doc.039a2c6c5274e5c3.translation: 默认为 1.0。粒子速度的缩放比例

label.e1dcce66aeae435f.translation: 基于魔咒位置的效果类型

doc.09e1ab09d8b3dc52.source: Level-Based Value determining the factor to multiply in
doc.09e1ab09d8b3dc52.translation: 决定乘数因子的基于等级的数值

doc.09bdf42cd5161b09.source: Scale factor applied to the given axis (`1` adds the velocity of the entity to the spawned particles). Defaults to 0.
doc.09bdf42cd5161b09.translation: 应用于给定轴的缩放因子（`1` 将实体的速度添加到生成的粒子中）。默认为 0。

Chance that an input value is dropped by 1.

The span is 0 to 1, with 0 being no chance to drop an input value and 1 dropping all input values.
doc.0d060090e4adc1e5.translation:
输入值减少 1 的概率。

范围为 0 到 1，其中 0 表示没有减少输入值的概率，1 表示减少所有输入值。

doc.15486ae90b424629.source: Relative coordinates to offset the placed block by. Defaults to `[0, 0, 0]`.
doc.15486ae90b424629.translation: 用于偏移放置方块的相对坐标。默认为 `[0, 0, 0]`。

doc.c70b800a35c614eb.source: If omitted, all block types are replaced.
doc.c70b800a35c614eb.translation: 如果省略，所有方块类型将被替换。

doc.3291bb8923077e2f.source: Defaults to no game event dispatched.
doc.3291bb8923077e2f.translation: 默认为不分发任何游戏事件。

doc.e805bf01a20addea.source: Relative coordinates to offset the center of the cylinder by. Defaults to `[0, 0, 0]`.
doc.e805bf01a20addea.translation: 用于偏移圆柱体中心的相对坐标。默认为 `[0, 0, 0]`。

doc.55a088ec0899e121.source: Relative coordinates to offset the block by. Defaults to `[0, 0, 0]`.
doc.55a088ec0899e121.translation: 用于偏移方块的相对坐标。默认为 `[0, 0, 0]`。

doc.38db114aa37987a5.source: If multiple entity types are specified, a random entity type is selected.
doc.38db114aa37987a5.translation: 如果指定了多种实体类型，将随机选择一种实体类型。

doc.9dfec0f1047064b7.source: Whether the summoned entity should join the team of the owner of the Enchanted Item.
doc.9dfec0f1047064b7.translation: 召唤的实体是否应加入附魔物品所有者的队伍。

doc.aa958b6dd6949d24.source:

Must be a subset of `supported_items`.
doc.aa958b6dd6949d24.translation:
此魔咒在附魔台和交易装备中出现的物品类型。

必须是 `supported_items` 的子集。

doc.14bf74c50bd1a32b.source: How commonly the Enchantment appears, compared to the total combined `weight` of all available Enchantments.
doc.14bf74c50bd1a32b.translation: 与所有可用魔咒的总 `weight` 相比，该魔咒出现的常见程度。

doc.83ab9a0b562dfc15.source:
Halved when an Enchantment is added to a book.
The effective fee is multiplied by the level of the Enchantment.
doc.83ab9a0b562dfc15.translation:
当魔咒添加到书上时减半。
有效费用乘以该魔咒的等级。

doc.3bd4633c39f239ff.translation: 高于1级的每级消耗增加量。

doc.e1e7e954da1ead94.translation: 高于1级的每级数值增加量。

doc.f863b07ea359a28e.translation: 若存在，则按 `level - 1` 索引应用

doc.cd6066addffa8174.source: Added to the result so that the result becomes `square(level) + added`.
doc.cd6066addffa8174.translation: 添加到结果中，使结果变为 `square(level) + added`。

doc.13d7f36b824a8cc5.source: Cost to use for the Enchanting process.

doc.4661d7e03b67db39.translation: 代表可能最小消耗的正整数

doc.7aec548ed3874019.source: Span of the cost randomization when the special factor is at its maximum.
doc.7aec548ed3874019.translation: 当特殊因子处于最大值时，消耗随机化的范围。

`this` is the entity drawing the weapon.
doc.14b0ed65b5db3cf0.translation:
谓词上下文：实体参数。

`this` 是挥舞武器的实体。

doc.6c77b833098c63a1.source:
Amount of projectiles being loaded/drawn. \
All projectile items except the first one will have `intangible_projectile` component applied.
doc.6c77b833098c63a1.translation:
加载/拔出的弹射物数量。 \
除第一个以外的所有弹射物物品都将应用 `intangible_projectile` 组件。
