Predicate context: Item Parameters.

Tool is the ammunition item.
doc.18d3617086cc0501.translation:
谓词上下文：物品参数。

Tool 是弹药物品。

doc.e7b973eb9b18610d.source: Amount of entities the projectile will pierce through before despawning.
doc.e7b973eb9b18610d.translation: 弹射物在消失前可穿透的实体数量。

doc.3c6829b1562d4636.source:
Predicate context: Entity Parameters.

`this` is the newly spawned projectile.
doc.3c6829b1562d4636.translation:
谓词上下文：实体参数。

`this` 是新生成的弹射物。

doc.76b537029af5758c.translation: 应用于新生成的弹射物上。

doc.c57a6468ea3313ef.source:
Predicate context: Entity Parameters.

`this` is the entity shooting the projectile.
doc.c57a6468ea3313ef.translation:
谓词上下文：实体参数。

`this` 是发射弹射物的实体。

doc.c6754b5740d63428.source: Maximum spread of projectiles measured in degrees from the aim line.
doc.c6754b5740d63428.translation: 以度为单位测量的弹射物最大扩散范围（相对于瞄准线）。

doc.4d86ad191533fc5d.source: Amount of durability increase per experience point, `mending` uses 2x.
doc.4d86ad191533fc5d.translation: 每点经验增加的耐久度数量，`mending` 使用 2 倍。

doc.e082c9a54bdc7bf7.source: Amount of damage dealt per block fallen.
doc.e082c9a54bdc7bf7.translation: 每下降一个方块造成的伤害量。

doc.3680a0948e55242e.source:
Predicate context: Entity Parameters.

`this` is the entity with the Enchanted Item.
doc.3680a0948e55242e.translation:
谓词上下文：实体参数。

`this` 是持有附魔物品的实体。

doc.23dfad1afa1a9c32.source: On every tick. Performance recommendation: don't use with `run_function` unless necessary.
doc.23dfad1afa1a9c32.translation: 每刻执行。性能建议：除非必要，否则不要与 `run_function` 配合使用。

doc.e43a15649712b972.source:
Predicate context: Entity Parameters.

`this` is the trident entity.
doc.e43a15649712b972.translation:
谓词上下文：实体参数。

`this` 是三叉戟实体。

doc.5b7dc0ac40bf9392.source: Amount of acceleration applied to the returning trident.
doc.5b7dc0ac40bf9392.translation: 应用于返回的三叉戟的加速度数量。

doc.c2136296135be963.source: The amount of exhaustion to apply to player.

doc.641fcb708ce6b38e.source:
Impulse direction in local coordinates (the same used by `tp @s ^ ^ ^`). \
`[left, upward, forward]`
doc.641fcb708ce6b38e.translation:
局部坐标系中的冲量方向（与 `tp @s ^ ^ ^` 使用的相同）。\
`[left, upward, forward]`

doc.eeea1da8d1fd7523.source:
The multipler to apply to the computed impulse direction. \
`[x, y, z]`
doc.eeea1da8d1fd7523.translation:
应用于计算出的冲量方向的乘数。\
`[x, y, z]`

doc.40699cb014b332ff.source:
Game tick supplied to `value` check gets modulo-divided by this.
For example, if set to 24000, `value` operates on a time period of days.
doc.40699cb014b332ff.translation:
提供给 `value` 检查的游戏刻将以此进行取模运算。
例如，如果设置为 24000，`value` 将以天为单位运行。

doc.b6ad4fbc45a47ebe.source: Passes when `value` is within this range.
doc.b6ad4fbc45a47ebe.translation: 当 `value` 在此范围内时通过。

doc.5382a159bc94cb13.source: Drops the items in a shulker box.

doc.6bf4ea6162065378.source: Drops the sherds of a decorated pot.

doc.019e2ea8b1c5977e.source: The icon used to mark the destination on the map.
doc.019e2ea8b1c5977e.translation: 用于在地图上标记目的地的图标。

doc.f79700ac0ea76232.source: The unique identifier of this attribute modifier.
doc.f79700ac0ea76232.translation: 此属性修改器的唯一标识符。

doc.6ee74771f128910a.source: The block entity type of the container.

doc.c97763dc141d43e1.source:
A block entity type. Unused by the game. \
The shortest word you can use is `bed` before 26.2, or `bell` in 26.2.
doc.c97763dc141d43e1.translation:
一个方块实体类型。游戏不使用。
在 26.2 版本之前，你可以使用的最短单词是 `bed`，在 26.2 版本中为 `bell`。

doc.4f8f3006602de7b2.source: The test environment to run this test as part of.
doc.4f8f3006602de7b2.translation: 作为该测试的一部分运行的测试环境。

doc.5f66c625efb8cdc1.source: Structure NBT file to use for the test.
doc.5f66c625efb8cdc1.translation: 测试中使用的结构 NBT 文件。

doc.5badbf3a73a5e7c8.source: Maximum number of ticks allowed to pass before the test is considered timed out.
doc.5badbf3a73a5e7c8.translation: 在测试被视为超时前允许通过的最大刻数。

doc.f6faac8ee929e229.source: Ticks to wait after placing the structure before starting the test. Defaults to `0`.
doc.f6faac8ee929e229.translation: 放置结构后开始测试前等待的刻数。默认为 `0`。

doc.4145b2e0d4c1084d.source: Whether the test is considered required to pass for the full test suite to pass. Defaults to `true`.
doc.4145b2e0d4c1084d.translation: 测试是否被视为必须通过才能使整个测试套件通过。默认为 `true`。

doc.ae2493e3b63a8b26.source: Rotation to apply to the test structure. Defaults to `none`.
doc.ae2493e3b63a8b26.translation: 应用于测试结构的旋转。默认为 `none`。

doc.7361fe0833ef3184.source: If `true`, test is not included as part of automated test runs. Defaults to `false`.
doc.7361fe0833ef3184.translation: 如果为 `true`，测试不包含在自动化测试运行中。默认为 `false`。

doc.dc50938c190ff8ec.source: Number of attempts to run the test. Defaults to `1`.
doc.dc50938c190ff8ec.translation: 运行测试的尝试次数。默认为 `1`。

doc.e123f1fdc771d496.source: Number of attempts that must succeed for the test to be considered successful. Defaults to `1`.
doc.e123f1fdc771d496.translation: 测试被视为成功的必要成功尝试次数。默认为 `1`。

doc.3b0a8d8eda4b41e0.source:
Whether the test needs clear access to the sky. Defaults to `false`.
If `false`, test is enclosed in barrier blocks. If `true`, the top is left open.
doc.3b0a8d8eda4b41e0.translation:
测试是否需要清晰的天空访问。默认为 `false`。
如果为 `false`，测试被屏障方块封闭。如果为 `true`，顶部保持开放。

doc.fe3e1c0105630f8f.source: Generated structure to locate. Accepts any of the structure types used by the `/locate` command. Defaults to buried treasure.
doc.fe3e1c0105630f8f.translation: 要定位的生成结构。接受 `/locate` 命令中使用的任何结构类型。默认为埋藏的宝藏。

doc.ac33b28c2952c682.source: Generated structure to locate. Accepts any of the structure types used by the `/locate` command.
doc.ac33b28c2952c682.translation: 要定位的生成结构。接受 `/locate` 命令中使用的任何结构类型。

doc.ee287d3d352ba8c7.source:
The icon used to mark the destination on the map. \
Some decoration types have corresponding map colors. The color of the lines on the item texture is changed to match the color.
doc.ee287d3d352ba8c7.translation:
在地图上标记目的地的图标。\
某些装饰类型有相应的地图颜色。物品纹理上的线条颜色将更改为匹配的颜色。

doc.b09c6120eb84ea42.source: The operation used for this modifier.

doc.feb770ae667e948f.source: If a list, one of the listed slots will be chosen randomly.
doc.feb770ae667e948f.translation: 如果是列表，将随机选择其中一个槽位。

doc.246267e9ca7daec9.source: If omitted, all components present are included
doc.246267e9ca7daec9.translation: 如果省略，则包含所有存在的组件

doc.39bb85188a00d896.source: Replace any existing contents of the target.
doc.39bb85188a00d896.translation: 替换目标的所有现有内容。

doc.bc4c8c5eeba60cc2.source: Rounded *after* the number was multiplied by the looting level.
doc.bc4c8c5eeba60cc2.translation: 在数字乘以抢夺等级*之后*进行四舍五入。

doc.2c81400519b1c8dd.source: Limits the count of the item to a range.
doc.2c81400519b1c8dd.translation: 将物品数量限制在范围内。

doc.a31c2986d03efaf9.source: If omitted, all enchantments applicable to the item are possible
doc.a31c2986d03efaf9.translation: 若省略，则所有适用于该物品的魔咒均可获得

doc.a1daa395efd4271e.source: The allowed enchantments. If omitted, all enchantments applicable to the item are possible.
doc.a1daa395efd4271e.translation: 允许的魔咒。若省略，则所有适用于该物品的魔咒均可获得。

doc.ebd28a04c8459de1.source:
Whether to only enchant with item-compatible enchantments. Defaults to `true`.

Note: Books are considered compatible with all Enchantments.
doc.ebd28a04c8459de1.translation:
是否仅使用与物品兼容的魔咒进行附魔。默认为 `true`。

注意：书被视为与所有魔咒兼容。

doc.2cea310d5dfd5db8.source:
Whether to add `additional_trade_cost` component to the enchanted item.
Additional cost value is determined by the enchantment level, with the formula `2 + random(0, 5 + level * 10) + 3 * level`.
Defaults to `false`.
doc.2cea310d5dfd5db8.translation:
是否向附魔后的物品添加 `additional_trade_cost` 组件。
额外消耗值由魔咒等级决定，公式为 `2 + random(0, 5 + level * 10) + 3 * level`。
默认为 `false`。

doc.3a3a7b93123c7dd8.source: The levels to enchant this item with.
doc.3a3a7b93123c7dd8.translation: 用于附魔此物品的等级。

doc.1689c569f27caa0e.source: Whether treasure enchantments are allowed on this item.
doc.1689c569f27caa0e.translation: 是否允许在此物品上获得宝藏魔咒。

doc.a7cb6152bc7439c0.source:
Whether to add `additional_trade_cost` component to the enchanted item.
Additional cost value is equal to the level cost determined by `levels`.
Defaults to `false`.
doc.a7cb6152bc7439c0.translation:
是否向附魔后的物品添加 `additional_trade_cost` 组件。
额外消耗值等于由 `levels` 决定的等级消耗。
默认为 `false`。

doc.8ad4f64ed8336269.source:
The size, in chunks, of the area to search for structures.
The area checked is square, not circular.
Radius `0` causes only the current chunk to be searched, radius `1` causes the current chunk and eight adjacent chunks to be searched, and so on.
Defaults to `50`.
doc.8ad4f64ed8336269.translation:
搜索结构的区域大小（以区块为单位）。
检查区域为正方形，而非圆形。
半径 `0` 仅搜索当前区块，半径 `1` 搜索当前区块及其相邻的八个区块，以此类推。
默认为 `50`。

doc.aee28419bfbb5a1c.source: Whether to not search in chunks that have already been generated. Defaults to `true`.
doc.aee28419bfbb5a1c.translation: 是否不在已生成的区块中进行搜索。默认为 `true`。

doc.b169f1ab13dbc359.source: `this` to use the entity that died or the player that gained the advancement, opened the container, or broke the block.
doc.b169f1ab13dbc359.translation: `this` 以使用死亡的实体或获得进度的玩家、打开容器或破坏方块的玩家。

doc.753ff1b90f78c587.source: Item predicate to select items to modify.
doc.753ff1b90f78c587.translation: 用于选择要修改物品的物品谓词。

doc.3848e1a2145612b4.source: Loot function to apply to the selected items.
doc.3848e1a2145612b4.translation: 应用于所选物品的战利品函数。

doc.6e5913a113a5e272.source: Loot function to apply to the item when `item_filter` passes.
doc.6e5913a113a5e272.translation: 当 `item_filter` 通过时应用于物品的战利品函数。

doc.d12437bce7d9127f.source: Loot function to apply to the item when `item_filter` fails.
doc.d12437bce7d9127f.translation: 当 `item_filter` 失败时应用于该物品的战利品函数。

doc.5e598266a9d28ecb.source: The offset in the list to insert into. Defaults to 0.
doc.5e598266a9d28ecb.translation: 要插入到列表中的偏移量。默认为 0。

doc.3791ba7fae963cdd.source: Determines how the existing list should be modified.
doc.3791ba7fae963cdd.translation: 确定如何修改现有列表。

doc.33a2ae9f24d914f2.source: Describes target component's items to modify.
doc.33a2ae9f24d914f2.translation: 描述要修改的目标组件中的物品。

doc.9dfd5ff6a5cb26ab.source: Applied to every item inside container.
doc.9dfd5ff6a5cb26ab.translation: 应用于容器内的每个物品。

doc.3a1f4967af5d9a50.source: The offset of the section to replace. Defaults to 0.
doc.3a1f4967af5d9a50.translation: 要替换的部分的偏移量。默认为 0。

doc.80afa5f1daa55fc0.source: The size of the section to replace. Defaults to size of the new list.
doc.80afa5f1daa55fc0.translation: 要替换部分的尺寸。默认为新列表的尺寸。

doc.166bd7cd3bc454d8.source: List of functions to apply to this item.
doc.166bd7cd3bc454d8.translation: 应用于此物品的函数列表。

doc.aec0a919d417715b.source: List of attribute modifiers to apply to this item.
doc.aec0a919d417715b.translation: 应用于此物品的属性修改器列表。

doc.a44754dd60777744.source: Whether to replace existing attributes (otherwise append to existing). Defaults to `true`.
doc.a44754dd60777744.translation: 是否替换现有属性（否则附加到现有属性）。默认为 `true`。

doc.c853c58ac33837a6.source: Whether to add to the banner pattern list.
doc.c853c58ac33837a6.translation: 是否添加到旗帜图案列表中。

doc.6f7deefd704459c0.source: If omitted, the original title is kept (or an empty string is used if there was no component)
doc.6f7deefd704459c0.translation: 如果省略，则保留原始标题（如果之前没有组件，则使用空字符串）

doc.1921902e1f2d2790.source: If omitted, the original author is kept (or an empty string is used if there was no component)
doc.1921902e1f2d2790.translation: 如果省略，则保留原始作者（如果之前没有组件，则使用空字符串）

doc.d43376755b16ebb9.source: If omitted, the original generation is kept (or 0 is used if there was no component)
doc.d43376755b16ebb9.translation: 如果省略，则保留原始生成值（如果之前没有组件，则使用 0）

doc.5d011abde69e3902.source: Describes target component to be filled with items.
doc.5d011abde69e3902.translation: 描述要填充物品的目标组件。

doc.be7cfe22b1d45fde.source:
Tag that describes the custom model an item will take.
Used by the `custom_model_data` model overrides predicate.
Has certain restrictions due to float conversion.
doc.be7cfe22b1d45fde.translation:
描述物品将采用的自定义模型的标签。
用于 `custom_model_data` 模型覆盖谓词。
由于浮点数转换，存在某些限制。

doc.9821a0cf1a7a1562.source: Additional padding in blocks placed around the structure. Defaults to `0`.
doc.9821a0cf1a7a1562.translation: 结构周围放置方块的额外填充。默认为 `0`。

doc.065cdcebbdefd12a.source:
If `true`, each of the items becomes an independent entry in the pool with the same `weight` and `quality`. \
If `false`, drops all items in the tag.
doc.065cdcebbdefd12a.translation:
如果为 `true`，每个物品都将成为战利品池中具有相同 `weight` 和 `quality` 的独立条目。\
如果为 `false`，掉落标签中的所有物品。

doc.c0e4fb2b488a5e5c.source:
If `true`, each of the items becomes an independent entry in the pool with the same `weight` and `quality`. \
If `false`, drops all items in the tag. \
Defaults to `false`.
doc.c0e4fb2b488a5e5c.translation:
如果 `true`，每个物品都成为战利品池中具有相同 `weight` 和 `quality` 的独立条目。
如果 `false`，掉落标签中的所有物品。
默认为 `false`。

doc.31cdb6ba692ce1f7.source: Passes when `value` is within the test range.
doc.31cdb6ba692ce1f7.translation: 当 `value` 在测试范围内时通过。

doc.b7198c03fb569086.source: Looting adjustment to the base success rate. Formula is `chance + (looting_level * looting_multiplier)` .
doc.b7198c03fb569086.translation: 抢夺对基础成功率的调整。公式为 `chance + (looting_level * looting_multiplier)` 。

doc.06928a2b60b48471.source: A cyclic reference causes a parsing failure.
doc.06928a2b60b48471.translation: 循环引用会导致解析失败。

doc.a8e1dc68410f0e72.source:
Applies specified number of random dyes to the item. \
For example, one possible outcome of `"number_of_dyes": 2` is `#2C3065`, which is the combination of a blue dye and a black dye. \
The same dye color can be selected multiple times.
doc.a8e1dc68410f0e72.translation:
将指定数量的随机染料应用于物品。\
例如，`"number_of_dyes": 2` 的一种可能结果是 `#2C3065`，即蓝色染料和黑色染料的组合。\
可以多次选择相同的染料颜色。

doc.ed592ae16d84239c.source:
Possible potions to select from.
Defaults to all potions.
doc.ed592ae16d84239c.translation:
可选的药水。
默认为所有药水。

doc.bbcd7fe167394afd.source: Sets the status effects for suspicious stew.
doc.bbcd7fe167394afd.translation: 设置谜之炖菜的状态效果。

doc.69fa6aa307e3fe07.source: Sets the pages of a book and quill.

doc.d6f8c45e74abd2dd.source: Sets the pages of a written book.

doc.2834611b391fd01a.source: The status effect of this stew effect.
doc.2834611b391fd01a.translation: 此炖菜效果的状态效果。

doc.8c02065d2ea3a0b6.source: The duration of this stew effect, in seconds.
doc.8c02065d2ea3a0b6.translation: 此炖菜效果的时间，单位为秒。

doc.5b033bdcefde4b6f.source:
If `true`, each of the loot tables becomes an independent entry in the pool with the same `weight` and `quality`. \
If `false`, drops all loot tables. \
Defaults to `false`.
doc.5b033bdcefde4b6f.translation:
如果 `true`，每个战利品表都成为池中具有相同 `weight` 和 `quality` 的独立条目。\
如果 `false`，则掉落所有战利品表。\
默认为 `false`。

doc.c19b96f0ca54a63a.source: Each condition is tested in order, the first in the list that passes is used.
doc.c19b96f0ca54a63a.translation: 按顺序测试每个条件，使用列表中第一个通过的条件。

label.4349835250fd008a.translation: 上下文浮点提供程序类型

doc.55ed6b2f59cd0828.source:
Decimal percentage. Can be negative when used in combination with `add`. \
Accepts a value between `-1` & `1` (inclusive).
doc.55ed6b2f59cd0828.translation:
十进制百分比。与 `add` 结合使用时可以为负值。
接受 `-1` 到 `1` 之间的值（包含边界）。

doc.3444b2f90a41ed4c.source: Whether to add to the existing damage of the item. Defaults to `false`.
doc.3444b2f90a41ed4c.translation: 是否添加到物品现有的伤害中。默认为 `false`。

doc.fb6315d9fcfcdf4e.source: A map of enchantments to levels. Setting an enchantment to `0` removes it from the item.
doc.fb6315d9fcfcdf4e.translation: 魔咒到等级的映射。将魔咒设置为 `0` 将其从物品中移除。

doc.325d6c270b31ba25.source: Whether to add to the level of each enchantment. Defaults to `false`.
doc.325d6c270b31ba25.translation: 是否添加到每个魔咒的等级中。默认为 `false`。

doc.0c180e5d309a2521.source: If omitted, the original shape is kept (or `small_ball` is used if there was no component).
doc.0c180e5d309a2521.translation: 如果省略，则保留原始形状（如果之前没有组件，则使用 `small_ball`）。

doc.d4d2de3973155b56.source:
If omitted, the original colors are kept (or `[]` is used if there was no component).
Calculated as `RED << 16 | GREEN << 8 | BLUE`. Each of these fields must be between 0 and 255, inclusive.
doc.d4d2de3973155b56.translation:
如果省略，则保留原始颜色（如果之前没有组件，则使用 `[]`）。
计算方式为 `RED << 16 | GREEN << 8 | BLUE`。这些字段中的每一个必须在 0 到 255 之间（包含边界）。

doc.49595ef67fa53854.source:
If omitted, the original fade colors are kept (or `[]` is used if there was no component).
Calculated as `RED << 16 | GREEN << 8 | BLUE`. Each of these fields must be between 0 and 255, inclusive.
doc.49595ef67fa53854.translation:
如果省略，则保留原始渐变颜色（如果之前没有组件，则使用 `[]`）。
计算方式为 `RED << 16 | GREEN << 8 | BLUE`。这些字段中的每一个必须在 0 到 255 之间（包含边界）。

doc.586eadb9e49543d6.source: If omitted, the original `has_trail` value is kept (or `false` is used if there was no component).
doc.586eadb9e49543d6.translation: 如果省略，则保留原始 `has_trail` 值（如果之前没有组件，则使用 `false`）。

doc.d7d8b3df41a670aa.source: If omitted, the original `has_twinkle` value is kept (or `false` is used if there was no component).
doc.d7d8b3df41a670aa.translation: 如果省略，则保留原始 `has_twinkle` 值（如果之前没有组件，则使用 `false`）。

doc.2ca30310ff0b12a4.source: If omitted, the flight duration of the item is left untouched - or set to 0 if the component did not exist before.
doc.2ca30310ff0b12a4.translation: 如果省略，则保持物品的飞行时间不变——如果之前不存在该组件，则设为 0。

doc.73cb922bc0c879a0.source: Sets the instrument tag for a goat horn.
doc.73cb922bc0c879a0.translation: 为山羊角设置乐器标签。

doc.50e090bd45886f44.source: The loot table to set to the container block item.
doc.50e090bd45886f44.translation: 要设置为容器方块物品的战利品表。

doc.b784c71012186a76.source: The container seed to use. Defaults to a random seed.
doc.b784c71012186a76.translation: 要使用的容器种子。默认为随机种子。

doc.1ef94c02376489ca.source: The ingredient that will transfer its data components to the result item.
doc.1ef94c02376489ca.translation: 将把数据组件转移到结果物品的原料。

doc.64bf75ece00f4173.source:
The allowed count of material.
Defaults to `1`.
doc.64bf75ece00f4173.translation:
允许的材料数量。
默认为 `1`。

label.19a069404b24ec4e.translation: 将材料数量添加到结果

doc.847695fc386cfb73.source:
When true, the number of materials will be added to the result count. \
Defaults to `false`.
doc.847695fc386cfb73.translation:
当为 true 时，材料数量将添加到结果数量中。 \
默认为 `false`。

doc.fca8f7bbd111a59c.source: The result item that will be merged with the input ingredient.
doc.fca8f7bbd111a59c.translation: 将与输入原料合并的结果物品。

doc.77cf28fd079c3109.source:
Determines if a notification is shown when unlocking this recipe.
Defaults to `true`.
doc.77cf28fd079c3109.translation:
决定在解锁此配方时是否显示通知。
默认为 `true`。

doc.58b0ca200730bd6e.source: Ingredient specifying an item to be trimmed. (eg. `"#minecraft:trimmable_armor"`)
doc.58b0ca200730bd6e.translation: 指定要进行纹饰的物品的原料。（例如 `"#minecraft:trimmable_armor"`）

doc.c23c10caee1a95fd.source: Ingredient specifying an item to be trimmed. (eg. `{ "tag": "minecraft:trimmable_armor" }`)
doc.c23c10caee1a95fd.translation: 指定要进行纹饰的物品的原料。（例如 `{ "tag": "minecraft:trimmable_armor" }`）

doc.f29a4d59d1935f8b.source: If an item targeted by `slot_source` has this container component, selects all items inside.
doc.f29a4d59d1935f8b.translation: 如果 `slot_source` 目标物品具有此容器组件，则选择其中所有物品。

doc.b20b2bfdef569e7c.source: Sets of different block states used in the structure, a random palette gets selected based on coordinates.
doc.b20b2bfdef569e7c.translation: 结构中使用的不同方块状态的集合，将根据坐标选择随机调色板。

doc.7c9ddbe88f59166e.source:
Additional ingredients. \
Multiple materials can be used at the same time. \
The number of materials beyond the first one will be added to the result count.
doc.7c9ddbe88f59166e.translation:
额外材料。\
可以同时使用多种材料。\
除第一个材料外的材料数量将添加到结果数量中。

doc.78717cb64895807b.source:
Limits the generation of the `source` item that can be copied.
Defaults to allow generation 0 and 1 (original and first copy).
doc.78717cb64895807b.translation:
限制可复制的 `source` 物品的生成数量。
默认为允许生成 0 和 1（原始物品和第一个副本）。

doc.02f40853f997e641.source:
Additional ingredient. \
Exactly 1 additional ingredient is required.
doc.02f40853f997e641.translation:
额外材料。\
需要恰好 1 个额外材料。

doc.cfd8b760188c0b0d.source:
The fuel ingredient. \
The count of fuel ingredients controls the `flight_duration` field. \
Only 1 ~ 3 fuels are allowed.
doc.cfd8b760188c0b0d.translation:
燃料材料。\
燃料材料的数量控制 `flight_duration` 字段。\
仅允许 1 ~ 3 个燃料。

doc.2f484f2c9d5c2039.source:
The firework star ingredient. \
Provides explosion data by the `firework_explosion` component. \
Any count of stars (including 0) are allowed.
doc.2f484f2c9d5c2039.translation:
烟花星火材料。\
通过 `firework_explosion` 组件提供爆炸数据。\
允许任意数量的星火（包括 0）。

doc.60a9bef3c931bb4d.source: The `fireworks` component is controlled by `fuel` and `star`.
doc.60a9bef3c931bb4d.translation: `fireworks` 组件由 `fuel` 和 `star` 控制。

doc.4fc66366830e3740.source: If this ingredient is provided, the result will have `has_trail` field set.
doc.4fc66366830e3740.translation: 如果提供了此材料，结果将设置 `has_trail` 字段。

doc.620705d82ebf9bb4.source: If this ingredient is provided, the result will have `has_twinkle` field set.
doc.620705d82ebf9bb4.translation: 如果提供了此材料，结果将设置 `has_twinkle` 字段。

doc.35375c47a8eae5ee.source:
The items to provide explosion color. \
Colors are provided by the `dye` component. \
Multiple dyes can be used at the same time.
doc.35375c47a8eae5ee.translation:
提供爆炸颜色的物品。\
颜色由 `dye` 组件提供。\
可以同时使用多种染料。

doc.4d7014c3879e4f90.source:
If one of the ingredients is provided, the result will have the corresponding `shape` value. \
If no shape ingredient is provided, the shape will be `small_ball`.
doc.4d7014c3879e4f90.translation:
如果提供了其中一种材料，结果将具有相应的 `shape` 值。\
如果未提供任何形状材料，形状将为 `small_ball`。

doc.5bb63f7fcb5d9643.source: The `firework_explosion` component is controlled by the ingredients.

doc.359465a6eb286051.source:
The firework star item. \
The fade effect of its `firework_explosion` will be changed. \
The other components are copied.
doc.359465a6eb286051.translation:
烟花星火物品。\
其 `firework_explosion` 的淡出效果将被更改。\
其他组件将被复制。

doc.00c188fbaa7d20b6.source:
The items to provide fade color. \
Colors are provided by the `dye` component. \
Multiple dyes can be used at the same time.
doc.00c188fbaa7d20b6.translation:
提供淡出颜色的物品。\
颜色由 `dye` 组件提供。\
可以同时使用多种染料。

doc.d5cd2506bb76a21e.source:
The map item. \
The `map_id` component is used to determine the resulting item. \
The other components are copied. \
This item is placed at the center grid. \
\
The source map will be kept in the crafting grid.
doc.d5cd2506bb76a21e.translation:
地图物品。\
使用 `map_id` 组件来确定结果物品。\
其他组件将被复制。\
此物品将被放置在中心网格。\
\
源地图将保留在合成网格中。

doc.21c04eac7b55fd5f.source:
Additional ingredients. \
8 `material` items are required to surroud the `map` item.
doc.21c04eac7b55fd5f.translation:
额外材料。\
需要 8 个 `material` 物品来包围 `map` 物品。

doc.0b097b55f07861df.source:
The previewing result will have `map_post_processing` transient component. \
The crafted result will have a new `map_id` component, which shows the extended version of the original map.
doc.0b097b55f07861df.translation:
预览结果将具有 `map_post_processing` 瞬时组件。\
合成结果将具有新的 `map_id` 组件，显示原始地图的扩展版本。

doc.d822856d34317d94.source:
The item to be decorated. It is required to have no patterns. \
Its components, except `base_color` and `banner_patterns`, are copied.
doc.d822856d34317d94.translation:
待装饰的物品。要求没有纹饰。\
除 `base_color` 和 `banner_patterns` 外，其组件将被复制。

doc.8256840549b7b11b.source:
The banner item. The item type is required to be `BannerItem`. \
Determines the `base_color` component of the resulting item.
doc.8256840549b7b11b.translation:
旗帜物品。物品类型要求为 `BannerItem`。\
确定结果物品的 `base_color` 组件。

doc.ccd7b4edf8745eb5.source: Whether the damage is attributed to the sulfur cube.
doc.ccd7b4edf8745eb5.translation: 伤害是否归属于硫方怪。

doc.856540743a8c9664.source:
The fuse time in ticks when ignited. \
When ignited by an explosion, the fuse will be a random value between `explosion_fuse / 8` and `3 * explosion_fuse / 8`.
doc.856540743a8c9664.translation:
点燃后的引信时间（单位：刻）。\
若由爆炸点燃，引信将为 `explosion_fuse / 8` 到 `3 * explosion_fuse / 8` 之间的随机值。

doc.443ebc97ba578497.source: The horizontal power of the knockback.

doc.33f447feebd0b47b.source: The vertical power of the knockback.

doc.bf0865c01b4f8b08.source: Minimum impact speed required to trigger the sound.
doc.bf0865c01b4f8b08.translation: 触发声音所需的最小冲击速度。

doc.dd29e92737292cca.source: Cooldown in seconds for the sound effect.
doc.dd29e92737292cca.translation: 声音效果的冷却时间（单位：秒）。

doc.cb9abcd88f8e5823.source: When present, sulfur cube with this archetype will explode when ignited.
doc.cb9abcd88f8e5823.translation: 若存在，具有此原型类型的硫方怪在点燃时会爆炸。

doc.475810aa797a84dc.source: Enchantment level is 1 in the effects.

doc.7be7bbf11bcdefe5.source:
Defaults to `linear`.
For visualization, check out: https://easings.net/
doc.7be7bbf11bcdefe5.translation:
默认为 `linear`。
用于可视化，请查看：https://easings.net/

doc.74fbf9ea49dd4f2b.source:
`[x1, y1, x2, y2]`
For an easy GUI, check out: https://cubic-bezier.com/
doc.74fbf9ea49dd4f2b.translation:
`[x1, y1, x2, y2]`
用于简单的 GUI，请查看：https://cubic-bezier.com/

doc.77d94dbd5f0b6c9e.source: When not present, the timeline will not repeat.
doc.77d94dbd5f0b6c9e.translation: 若不存在，时间轴将不会重复。

doc.bf5ed08e34d2c244.source: The world clock this timeline is tied to.
doc.bf5ed08e34d2c244.translation: 此时间轴绑定的世界时钟。

doc.bd53ffbb19e1d8ed.source:
Whether the time marker shows up in command suggestions. \
The time marker is still available in commands even if it is not suggested. \
Defaults to `false`.
doc.bd53ffbb19e1d8ed.translation:
时间标记是否显示在命令建议中。
即使未被建议，时间标记仍可在命令中使用。
默认为 `false`。

doc.92f3282919dcec70.source: Time marker ID must be unique within the world clock.
doc.92f3282919dcec70.translation: 时间标记 ID 在世界时钟内必须唯一。

doc.ea2e7becca8bd320.source: Amount of trades to be generated.

doc.46486786d487372e.source: Probability of a single coin flip succeeding.
doc.46486786d487372e.translation: 单次硬币投掷成功的概率。

doc.815ad480dbef3cde.source: Identifier to group multiple recipes in the recipe book.
doc.815ad480dbef3cde.translation: 在配方书中对多个配方进行分组的标识符。

doc.67c9af3888a39799.source:
Whether the trade set can use the same generator multiple times and generate duplicate trades.
Defaults to `false`.
doc.67c9af3888a39799.translation:
交易集是否可以使用相同的生成器多次使用并生成重复的交易。
默认为 `false`。

doc.9112020fb5067236.source: Maximum distance from the spawner that en entity can spawn
doc.9112020fb5067236.translation: 实体可从生成器生成的最大距离

doc.3aa64537d5a2d183.source: Total amount of entities that are spawned during one activation, when 1 player is nearby
doc.3aa64537d5a2d183.translation: 当 1 名玩家在附近时，单次激活期间生成的实体总数

label.4db23fc4a0719462.translation: 每名玩家增加的总怪物数量

doc.fc4d98d596529f9d.source: Number added to `total_mobs` for each additional player
doc.fc4d98d596529f9d.translation: 每增加一名玩家到 `total_mobs` 中增加的数量

doc.84bd1880c7066b08.source: Number of entities that that can be present at once, when 1 player is nearby
doc.84bd1880c7066b08.translation: 当 1 名玩家在附近时，可同时存在的实体数量

label.b8f1f0a06f954e38.translation: 每名玩家增加的同時存在怪物数量

doc.179fab910a58afc9.source: Number added to `simultaneous_mobs` for each additional player
doc.179fab910a58afc9.translation: 每增加一名玩家到 `simultaneous_mobs` 中增加的数量

doc.d5a8758c24e85d32.source: Loot tables to use when ejecting loot. Chooses one loot table based on weight and then uses it as often as there are players nearby.
doc.d5a8758c24e85d32.translation: 剔除战利品时使用的战利品表。根据权重选择一个战利品表，然后根据附近玩家的数量多次使用。

doc.640f5b3ef07d3f89.source: Loot table to use when summoning ominous item spawners. One roll seeded based on rough location to determine all items used during the battle.
doc.640f5b3ef07d3f89.translation: 召唤不祥物品生成器时使用的战利品表。根据大致位置进行一次种子化抽取，以确定战斗期间使用的所有物品。

doc.70263a86f3f1fea2.source:
ID of the pattern that will be used in the resource pack as an overlay on the armor. \
Leggings layer adds `_leggings` suffix automatically.
doc.70263a86f3f1fea2.translation:
资源包中将作为护甲覆盖层使用的图案 ID。 \
护腿层会自动添加 `_leggings` 后缀。

doc.a6974eb317beaeee.source:
ID of the pattern that will be used in the resource pack as an overlay on the armor. \
The texture is located under `trims/entity/<layer>/`.
doc.a6974eb317beaeee.translation:
资源包中将作为护甲覆盖层使用的图案 ID。 \
纹理位于 `trims/entity/<layer>/` 下。

doc.74c97965cd79d1bf.source: Permutation key which will be used in the resource pack.
doc.74c97965cd79d1bf.translation: 资源包中将使用的置换键。

doc.3dc9d9a4df96241f.source: Palette ID which will be used in the resource pack.
doc.3dc9d9a4df96241f.translation: 在资源包中使用的调色板 ID。

doc.d58b24013d99071c.source: Text displayed in the item tooltip.
doc.d58b24013d99071c.translation: 显示在物品工具提示中的文本。

doc.6bb79ef2e0fa8cf6.source: Item used in the smithing table for this material.
doc.6bb79ef2e0fa8cf6.translation: 用于此材料的锻造台物品。

doc.1fe76a26029db499.source: Armor materials that should have a different color palette.
doc.1fe76a26029db499.translation: 应具有不同颜色调色板的护甲材料。

doc.71200eef170df818.source: The item used in the smithing table for this pattern.
doc.71200eef170df818.translation: 用于此图案的锻造台物品。

doc.60efdc6ecdca3f78.source: Whether the pattern texture will be masked based on the underlying armor. Defaults to `false`.
doc.60efdc6ecdca3f78.translation: 图案纹理是否根据底层护甲进行遮罩。默认为 `false`。

label.4e9747762acb87de.translation: 战利品评分提供者类型

label.602be0a2be40fea9.translation: 战利品 NBT 提供者类型

doc.6b3b69b32cf05536.source: Range in blocks. If the player is further than this range from the source of the sound, the sound will be inaudible. If omitted, the sound will have a variable range.
doc.6b3b69b32cf05536.translation: 以方块为单位的范围。如果玩家距离声音源超过此范围，则将听不到声音。如果省略，声音将具有可变范围。

doc.4bc337b6911375c9.source: Translation key prefix per dye color (e.g. `block.minecraft.banner.custom.pattern` resolves to `block.minecraft.banner.custom.pattern.<dye color>`).
doc.4bc337b6911375c9.translation: 每种染料颜色的翻译键前缀（例如 `block.minecraft.banner.custom.pattern` 解析为 `block.minecraft.banner.custom.pattern.<dye color>`）。

doc.1047ce8829da93c6.source: Checks if the entity is spawning in specific biomes.
doc.1047ce8829da93c6.translation: 检查实体是否在特定生物群系中生成。

doc.481979746be9fd05.source: Identifier for the category this goes in the recipe book.
doc.481979746be9fd05.translation: 该配方在配方书中的标识符。

doc.63313341351fc7f2.source: The `pot_decorations` component will store the 4 ingredients.
doc.63313341351fc7f2.translation: `pot_decorations` 组件将存储 4 种原料。

doc.edbfe25615d8bb57.source:
The item to be dyed. \
Its `dyed_color` component will be dyed. The other components are copied.
doc.edbfe25615d8bb57.translation:
将被染色的物品。 \
其 `dyed_color` 组件将被染色。其他组件将被复制。

doc.527b7868ba398aa5.source:
The items to provide dye color. \
Colors are provided by the `dye` component. \
Multiple dyes can be used at the same time.
doc.527b7868ba398aa5.translation:
提供染色颜色的物品。 \
颜色由 `dye` 组件提供。 \
可以同时使用多种染料。

doc.641f3233d7682233.source:
The item to provide potion effect. \
Its `potion_contents` component will be copied. \
This item is placed at the center grid.
doc.641f3233d7682233.translation:
提供药水效果的物品。 \
其 `potion_contents` 组件将被复制。 \
此物品放置在中心网格。

doc.b3f5aeb6bb7e9c5b.source:
Additional ingredients. \
8 `material` items are required to surroud the `source` item.
doc.b3f5aeb6bb7e9c5b.translation:
额外原料。 \
需要 8 个 `material` 物品围绕 `source` 物品。

doc.b8ccc35dece5480b.source:
The banner item. The item type is required to be `BannerItem`. \
Exactly 2 banners of the same color are required. \
The one with patterns is viewed as "source". Its components will be copied. \
The other is viewed as "target". It is required to have no patterns. \
\
The source banner will be kept in the crafting grid.
doc.b8ccc35dece5480b.translation:
旗帜物品。物品类型必须为 `BannerItem`。 \
需要正好 2 个颜色相同的旗帜。 \
带有图案的被视为“源”。其组件将被复制。 \
另一个被视为“目标”。它必须没有图案。 \
\
源旗帜将保留在合成网格中。

doc.5a1d08a5d77a03c3.source:
The book item. \
Its `written_book_contents` component will be copied, with `generation` value increased by 1. \
The other components are copied as-is. \
\
The book will be kept in the crafting grid.
doc.5a1d08a5d77a03c3.translation:
书本物品。 \
其 `written_book_contents` 组件将被复制，且 `generation` 值增加 1。 \
其他组件将按原样复制。 \
\
书本将保留在合成网格中。

doc.86d6155e84f93fd4.source: The cat texture to use for this variant.

doc.cfa25461050cc1de.source: The baby cat texture to use for this variant.
doc.cfa25461050cc1de.translation: 此变体使用的幼猫纹理。

doc.8b6f329fc84bfb14.source: The chicken texture to use for this variant.

doc.f59c74b9a9790796.source: The baby chicken texture to use for this variant.
doc.f59c74b9a9790796.translation: 此变体使用的幼鸡纹理。

doc.5285d1dd4bb0192d.source: The cow texture to use for this variant.

doc.4e45e87db3f9ee9a.source: The baby cow texture to use for this variant.
doc.4e45e87db3f9ee9a.translation: 此变体使用的幼牛纹理。

doc.76accddd25d0198e.source: The frog texture to use for this variant.
doc.76accddd25d0198e.translation: 此变体使用的青蛙纹理。

doc.3fd1e80ce98dd467.source: Maximum range in blocks that the sound can be heard
doc.3fd1e80ce98dd467.translation: 音效可hear的最大方块范围

doc.2bc7d4c5ef328d06.source: Duration of use in seconds, used as item cooldown
doc.2bc7d4c5ef328d06.translation: 以秒为单位的使用时间，用作物品冷却时间

doc.0a4a8bc2aacbaed7.source: Displayed in the HUD actionbar & item tooltip.
doc.0a4a8bc2aacbaed7.translation: 显示在HUD动作栏和物品提示中。

doc.7390ec7bd8fe4a09.source: Checks if the current moon brightness is within a certain range.
doc.7390ec7bd8fe4a09.translation: 检查当前的月亮亮度是否在特定范围内。

doc.a9bdf1b75ac2698b.source: Overrides default music when in creative mode
doc.a9bdf1b75ac2698b.translation: 在创造模式时覆盖默认音乐

doc.768c3135c0ee7968.source: The pig texture to use for this variant.

doc.9062d44a7edd8cba.source: The baby pig texture to use for this variant.
doc.9062d44a7edd8cba.translation: 此变体使用的幼猪贴图。

doc.032b6dd846f83e03.source: The spawn condition to check. If not present, the condition always matches.
doc.032b6dd846f83e03.translation: 要检查的生成条件。若不存在，则条件始终匹配。

doc.823723361c679d4b.source:
The spawn conditions for this variant. Selection process:
- Conditions for all variants for the given entity type are evaluated for the spawn position
- Entries with a priority lower than the maximum priority of the remaining entries are removed
- A random entry is picked out of the remaining ones
- If no conditions are remaining, the variant remains unchanged from the default
doc.823723361c679d4b.translation:
此变体的生成条件。选择过程：
- 评估给定实体类型所有变体的条件以匹配生成位置
- 移除优先级低于剩余条目中最大优先级的条目
- 从剩余条目中随机选择一个
- 若没有剩余条件，变体保持默认状态

doc.ed2104c4048904d5.source: Checks if the entity is spawning in specific structures.
doc.ed2104c4048904d5.translation: 检查实体是否在特定结构中生成。

doc.d85d8d019f2d9e3a.source: The texture set to use for this wolf variant.
doc.d85d8d019f2d9e3a.translation: 此狼变体使用的贴图集。

doc.2e7a2788a1c05404.source: The baby texture set to use for this wolf variant.
doc.2e7a2788a1c05404.translation: 此狼变体使用的幼体贴图集。

doc.7b5fb6e29603df4c.source: The zombie nautilus texture to use for this variant.
doc.7b5fb6e29603df4c.translation: 此变体使用的僵尸鹦鹉螺贴图。

doc.5a736265218561f3.source: The gray color is `brightness * (0.3 * r + 0.59 * g + 0.11 * b)`.

doc.ffd3309f01fad253.source: Raises or lowers the terrain. Positive values are considered land and negative are oceans.
doc.ffd3309f01fad253.translation: 抬高或降低地形。正值视为陆地，负值视为海洋。

doc.d61632ac84d91d08.source: Vertically stretches the terrain. Lower values produce flatter terrain.
doc.d61632ac84d91d08.translation: 垂直拉伸地形。较低的值会产生更平坦的地形。

doc.fc5fb21b768a6d24.source: If true, the world spawn will be preferred in this biome.
doc.fc5fb21b768a6d24.translation: 如果为是，世界生成将优先在此时生物群系。

doc.fbab3d4378dd2a53.source:
Price item required by the merchant. \
The count is affected by various factors, including offered item, demand and player reputation.
doc.fbab3d4378dd2a53.translation:
商人要求的价格物品。\
数量受多种因素影响，包括提供的物品、需求和玩家声望。

doc.146b94fa7ebc159f.source:
Second item required by the merchant. \
The count is not affected by any factors.
doc.146b94fa7ebc159f.translation:
商人要求的第二个物品。\
数量不受任何因素影响。

doc.33ef430bdfd0ee54.source: Item being offered by the merchant.

doc.f80fabcdd3bc833b.source:
Modifiers applied to the `gives` item. \
Does **not** support `reference` item modifier. \
Some modifiers can affect the price through the `additional_trade_cost` transient component. \
The `additional_trade_cost` component is not saved on the offered item.
doc.f80fabcdd3bc833b.translation:
应用于 `gives` 物品的修改器。\
**不支持** `reference` 物品修改器。\
某些修改器可以通过 `additional_trade_cost` 瞬时组件影响价格。\
`additional_trade_cost` 组件不会保存在提供的物品上。

doc.264cc36d22a6da13.source:
Modifiers applied to the `gives` item. \
Does **not** support `reference` item modifier. \
Some modifiers can affect the price through the `additional_trade_cost` transient component. \
The `additional_trade_cost` component is not saved on the offered item.

ID reference is not allowed here.
doc.264cc36d22a6da13.translation:
应用于 `gives` 物品的修改器。\
**不支持** `reference` 物品修改器。\
某些修改器可以通过 `additional_trade_cost` 瞬时组件影响价格。\
`additional_trade_cost` 组件不会保存在提供的物品上。

此处不允许 ID 引用。

doc.93c08bdd0f9b3aec.source: Maximum number of uses of this trade before the villager has to restock. Defaults to `4`.
doc.93c08bdd0f9b3aec.translation: 在村民重新上货前此交易的最大使用次数。默认为 `4`。

doc.8ee4376f161a772a.source: How much demand & reputation each affect the price, is serialized as `priceMultiplier`. Defaults to `0.0`.
doc.8ee4376f161a772a.translation: 需求和声望对价格的影响程度，序列化为 `priceMultiplier`。默认为 `0.0`。

doc.a7b2ca9c4f2b0844.source: Amount to increase the merchant's XP score by that determines their trade tier. Defaults to `1`.
doc.a7b2ca9c4f2b0844.translation: 增加商人经验值的数量，该值决定其交易等级。默认为 `1`。

doc.254cfe3c46c59448.source:
Check whether the trade should be offered by the merchant. \
Does **not** support the `reference` predicate.
doc.254cfe3c46c59448.translation:
检查商人是否应提供该交易。\
**不支持** `reference` 谓词。

doc.7fec2e1aa47f046b.source: If the offered enchanted book has the specified enchantments, the price will be affected by doubling the `additional_trade_cost` transient component.
doc.7fec2e1aa47f046b.translation: 如果提供的附魔书具有指定的附魔，价格将通过翻倍 `additional_trade_cost` 瞬时组件受到影响。

doc.81147136b3567d16.source:
The volume of the music in this biome. Defaults to 1.
The game will smoothly transition between the current music volume and the new volume when entering the biome.
doc.81147136b3567d16.translation:
此生物群系中的音乐音量。默认为 1。
进入生物群系时，游戏将平滑过渡到新的音乐音量。

doc.fcb6f95c3df57771.source: Grass color will be average of the base color and `#28340a`.
doc.fcb6f95c3df57771.translation: 草地颜色将是基础颜色与 `#28340a` 的平均值。

doc.fa290ff0ef10c43f.source:
Grass color will be either `#4c763c` or `#6a7039`, depending on block position. \
The base color is ignored.
doc.fa290ff0ef10c43f.translation:
草地颜色将根据方块位置为 `#4c763c` 或 `#6a7039`。
基础颜色将被忽略。

doc.6c181dc49474b21a.source:
Defaults to constant 0. \
At least one of the offsets must be specified.
doc.6c181dc49474b21a.translation:
默认为常数 0。\
必须指定至少一个偏移量。

doc.1dfe170cc6196a08.source: Must have exactly one fewer element than `functions`.
doc.1dfe170cc6196a08.translation: 必须比 `functions` 少恰好一个元素。

doc.cc1742cd33007a12.source: Must have exactly one more element than `thresholds`.
doc.cc1742cd33007a12.translation: 必须比 `thresholds` 多恰好一个元素。

doc.d895f6a2ce1d81da.source:
When empty or not present, defaults to all 1.0. \
Otherwise, the size must match `octave_count`.
doc.d895f6a2ce1d81da.translation:
当为空或不存在时，默认为所有 1.0。\
否则，大小必须与 `octave_count` 匹配。

label.2593c543512d2677.translation: 旧版本生物群系初始化层

doc.afe5dc571dc98027.source:
An additional operation performed on dialog after click or submit actions.
Defaults to `close`. \
Value `none` requires `pause` set to `false`.
doc.afe5dc571dc98027.translation:
在点击或提交操作后对对话框执行的额外操作。
默认为 `close`。
值 `none` 要求 `pause` 设置为 `false`。

doc.348a7fbed3e8590b.source: Label displayed to the right of control.
doc.348a7fbed3e8590b.translation: 显示在控件右侧的标签。

doc.7fd05e813ae3c00e.source:
Initial value of the control.
Defaults to `false` (unchecked).
doc.7fd05e813ae3c00e.translation:
控件的初始值。
默认为 `false`（未勾选）。

doc.1f526eb20cbf6803.source:
String to send when the control is checked.
Defaults to `"true"`.
doc.1f526eb20cbf6803.translation:
当控件被勾选时发送的字符串。
默认为 `"true"`。

doc.b4edbaf432367b78.source:
String to send when the control is unchecked.
Defaults to `"false"`.
doc.b4edbaf432367b78.translation:
当控件未被勾选时发送的字符串。
默认为 `"false"`。

doc.8a7b30fa9fabb7e2.source: The input key, which is used to build macro command and generate custom action payload.
doc.8a7b30fa9fabb7e2.translation: 用于构建宏命令并生成自定义操作有效载荷的输入键。

doc.fd7dc5665a95eda5.source:
Height of the input.
If this field is not present:
- If `max_lines` is present, the height will be chosen to fit the maximum number of lines. The chosen height is capped at 512.
- If `max_lines` is also not present, the height will be chosen to fit 4 lines.
doc.fd7dc5665a95eda5.translation:
输入的高度。
如果不存在此字段：
- 如果存在 `max_lines`，高度将选择以适应最大行数。选择的高度上限为 512。
- 如果 `max_lines` 也不存在，高度将选择以适应 4 行。

doc.ae29a73b82eed02b.source: Portals can't spawn and chorus fruit can't teleport players above this height.
doc.ae29a73b82eed02b.translation: 传送门无法生成，且紫颂果无法传送玩家到此高度以上。

doc.1f947de12d6879cd.translation:
天空盒类型。
默认为 `overworld`。

doc.48dde1d5b9bcf718.source: The direction of cardinal lighting that affects blocks.
doc.48dde1d5b9bcf718.translation: 影响方块的主方向光照方向。

doc.5fd244042f12d96d.source: Defining what blocks keep fire infinitely burning.
doc.5fd244042f12d96d.translation: 定义哪些方块可以无限燃烧。

doc.94f5761d372a125b.source: The minimum height in which blocks can exist.
doc.94f5761d372a125b.translation: 方块可以存在的最小高度。

doc.4837438da83cc806.source: The total height in which blocks can exist. Max Y = Min Y + Height.
doc.4837438da83cc806.translation: 方块可以存在的总高度。最大 Y = 最小 Y + 高度。

label.cf8d33c0fb84489c.translation: 怪物生成方块光照限制

doc.201633dccf8bc031.source: The Y-level where the clouds start in the dimension. If not present, no clouds will be visible.
doc.201633dccf8bc031.translation: 维度中云层开始的 Y 层级。若不存在，则将不可见任何云层。

doc.622dbdef2fbb2c0e.source: If true, water will evaporate and sponges will dry.
doc.622dbdef2fbb2c0e.translation: 如果为是，水将蒸发且海绵将变干。

doc.1453672b272eb843.source: If true, portals will spawn zombified piglins. If false, compasses and clocks spin randomly.
doc.1453672b272eb843.translation: 如果为是，传送门将生成僵尸化猪灵。如果为否，指南针和时钟将随机旋转。

doc.4153849f0a2395ff.source: If false, piglins will shake and convert to zombified piglins.
doc.4153849f0a2395ff.translation: 如果为否，猪灵将颤抖并转化为僵尸化猪灵。

doc.2e0f1bde03ffb5a5.source: If true, players can charge and use respawn anchors to set their spawn. If false, respawn anchors will blow up when used.
doc.2e0f1bde03ffb5a5.translation: 如果为是，玩家可以为重生锚充电并使用它们来设置重生点。如果为否，使用重生锚时会爆炸。

doc.781e7577ce5bc169.source: If true, players can use beds to set their spawn and advance time. If false, beds will blow up when used.
doc.781e7577ce5bc169.translation: 如果为是，玩家可以使用床来设置重生点并推进时间。如果为否，使用床时会爆炸。

doc.768e79ab4733ee83.source: If true, players with the Bad Omen effect can cause a raid.
doc.768e79ab4733ee83.translation: 如果为是，带有不祥之兆效果的玩家可以引发袭击。

doc.07a54ed82b2e9fcc.source: Affects the weather, lighting engine and respawning rules.
doc.07a54ed82b2e9fcc.translation: 影响天气、光照引擎和重生规则。

doc.a21eaa09b207235e.source: Affects the weather, map items and respawning rules.
doc.a21eaa09b207235e.translation: 影响天气、地图物品和重生规则。

doc.bd6842362ef80dbf.source: Setting this value will keep the sun in a fixed position.
doc.bd6842362ef80dbf.translation: 设置此值将使太阳保持在固定位置。

doc.33c910e0672ba127.source: The effective reach is limited by `height`.
doc.33c910e0672ba127.translation: 有效可达范围受 `height` 限制。

doc.0c7a1e820c0f5f20.source:
The translation to be used for building label.
`%1$s` is replaced by `label`; `%2$s` is replaced by current value of the slider.
Defaults to `options.generic_value`.
doc.0c7a1e820c0f5f20.translation:
用于构建标签的翻译。
`%1$s` 被替换为 `label`；`%2$s` 被替换为滑块的当前值。
默认为 `options.generic_value`。

doc.48d218b9eb311415.source:
Step size of the input.
If not present, any value from range is allowed.
doc.48d218b9eb311415.translation:
输入的步长。
若未设置，则允许范围内的任何值。

doc.04124e90bbc05eeb.source:
Initial value of the slider. Rounded down nearest step.
Defaults to the middle of the range.
doc.04124e90bbc05eeb.translation:
滑块的初始值。向下舍入到最近的步长。
默认为范围的中点。

doc.c1187a3a5df6cfc1.source:
Label displayed on the button.
When not present, `id` will be used instead.
doc.c1187a3a5df6cfc1.translation:
按钮上显示的标签。
若未设置，将使用 `id` 代替。

doc.f0395f66d6ee5b02.source: If more corners are exposed to air, feature placement is cancelled.
doc.f0395f66d6ee5b02.translation: 如果暴露在空气中的角更多，则取消地物生成。

label.7555a79fa6a1218b.translation: 地板到天花板搜索范围

doc.ad23447a1576bca1.source: Blocks that will not be replaced by the geode.
doc.ad23447a1576bca1.translation: 不会被地穴矿石替换的方块。

doc.78a20c0dab43d502.source: When encountering an invalid block, feature placement is cancelled.
doc.78a20c0dab43d502.translation: 遇到无效方块时，地物放置将被取消。

label.d4fb04abce9dd5d0.source: Can replace with air or fluid
label.d4fb04abce9dd5d0.translation: 可以替换为空气或流体

label.a90fa2de8691d5ad.source: Max column radius to cave height ratio
label.a90fa2de8691d5ad.translation: 最大列半径与洞穴高度比

label.1ee831dab8b046a2.translation: 暴露于空气时的放弃概率

doc.c0eaafaa3bd5c848.source: Chance that feature placement will be discarded if the ore is exposed to air blocks.
doc.c0eaafaa3bd5c848.translation: 如果矿石暴露于空气方块，地物放置将被放弃的概率。

doc.53a588873aa9d4fe.source:
The features to generate, in order. \
All features are placed regardless of individual placement success.
doc.53a588873aa9d4fe.translation:
按顺序生成的地物。 \
所有地物无论单个放置是否成功都会被放置。

doc.e6c499a047357808.source: Fixed list of block positions to place the feature at.
doc.e6c499a047357808.translation: 用于放置地物的固定方块位置列表。

doc.c73ea4dad0f5d736.source: How many attempts will be made to find a placement. Defaults to 128.
doc.c73ea4dad0f5d736.translation: 寻找放置位置的尝试次数。默认为 128。

label.1911ff63d4ccec77.translation: 悬挂式垂根放置尝试次数

label.aaf5334c66de6383.translation: 悬挂式垂根状态提供程序

doc.7b4613b14cd14a99.source:
The features to generate, in order. \
If any feature in the list is not placed, the following features will also be skipped.
doc.7b4613b14cd14a99.translation:
按顺序生成的地物。\
如果列表中任何地物未被放置，后续地物也将被跳过。

doc.7893244242c562e6.source: Whether to schedule a block update. Defaults to `false`.
doc.7893244242c562e6.translation: 是否调度方块更新。默认为 `false`。

label.e1095f2702499f05.translation: 最大石笋与钟乳石高度差

doc.17a2f28e7a69e78e.source: Max height difference between the stalagmite and stalactite.
doc.17a2f28e7a69e78e.translation: 石笋与钟乳石之间的最大高度差。

label.83b049f023fe805f.source: Chance of dripstone column at max distance from center
label.83b049f023fe805f.translation: 距离中心最大距离处的滴水石柱几率

label.e9f49cd4eaebb003.source: Chance of speleothem at max distance from center
label.e9f49cd4eaebb003.translation: 距离中心最大距离处的钟乳石几率

label.6dac6d14443b619b.source: Max distance from edge affecting chance of dripstone column
label.6dac6d14443b619b.translation: 影响滴水石柱几率的边缘最大距离

label.b344b8339387aaf1.source: Max distance from edge affecting chance of speleothem
label.b344b8339387aaf1.translation: 影响钟乳石生成概率的边缘最大距离

label.01e74cdeb7d7c01d.source: Max distance from center affecting height bias
label.01e74cdeb7d7c01d.translation: 影响高度偏置的中心最大距离

doc.b07399ea26fa133f.source:
Rotations to choose from and apply to this template, centered around the origin.
If not specified, defaults to all allowed rotations.
doc.b07399ea26fa133f.translation:
可供选择并应用于此模板的旋转，以原点为中心。
如果未指定，则默认为所有允许的旋转。

doc.68e98f5555410091.source: The block to place on the ground.

label.b77b7ecc94757e7e.translation: 每个有效位置的放置概率

doc.03ddc63532374a1f.source: Relative position of the bedrock roof starting at the world height. Higher numbers move the roof down.
doc.03ddc63532374a1f.translation: 从世界高度开始的基岩顶层相对位置。数值越高，顶层越向下移动。

doc.12fc4c88254e5487.source: If true, mobs will not spawn during generation.
doc.12fc4c88254e5487.translation: 如果为是，生成期间将不会生成生物。

doc.fe01a4cdd5b9d2c7.source: Minimum height where blocks start generating.
doc.fe01a4cdd5b9d2c7.translation: 方块开始生成的最小高度。

doc.f832bc3c9fce4e6a.source: The total height where blocks can generate. Max Y = Min Y + Height.
doc.f832bc3c9fce4e6a.translation: 方块可生成的总高度。最大 Y = 最小 Y + 高度。

doc.479746168b67b9a5.source: Adds or removes terrain at the top of the world. Does nothing when size is 0.
doc.479746168b67b9a5.translation: 在世界顶部添加或移除地形。当尺寸为 0 时无效。

doc.594416aaff27cdaf.source: Average distance in chunks between two structures of this type.
doc.594416aaff27cdaf.translation: 此类两种结构之间的平均区块距离。

doc.5e60ac3d0bd0a582.source: Minimum distance in chunks between two structures of this type.
doc.5e60ac3d0bd0a582.translation: 此类两种结构之间的最小区块距离。

doc.48392f0376ee8ff6.source: The step when the structure generates.

doc.6bc3596942b0d7fc.source: Whether to add extra terrain below the structure.
doc.6bc3596942b0d7fc.translation: 是否在结构下方添加额外地形。

label.9d4491967ef6612e.translation: 将项目起始点投影到高度图

doc.fd97e181317ab779.source: Adds or removes terrain at the bottom of the world. Does nothing when size is 0.
doc.fd97e181317ab779.translation: 在世界底部添加或移除地物。当大小为 0 时无效。

doc.2ca28b2305810c19.source: If true, terrain will be shaped like islands similar to the end.
doc.2ca28b2305810c19.translation: 如果为是，地形将像末地一样呈现出岛屿形状。

doc.45170a4e6ff9a753.source: The target density. Positive values add terrain and negative values remove terrain.
doc.45170a4e6ff9a753.translation: 目标致密。正值添加地物，负值移除地物。

doc.3ed47c2ce4774872.source: Defines a range of 'Size * Size vertical * 4' blocks where the existing density and target are interpolated.
doc.3ed47c2ce4774872.translation: 定义一个范围为 'Size * Size vertical * 4' 的方块区域，其中现有的致密与目标值进行插值。

doc.16e1cb4928740ea1.source: Defines an range of 'Offset * Size vertical * 4' blocks where the density is set to the target.
doc.16e1cb4928740ea1.translation: 定义一个范围为 'Offset * Size vertical * 4' 的方块区域，其中致密被设置为目标值。

doc.bd0d8e8621c6796c.source: Language name displayed in the language menu.
doc.bd0d8e8621c6796c.translation: 语言菜单中显示的语言名称。

doc.c61f7151f30e9623.source: Region name displayed in the language menu.
doc.c61f7151f30e9623.translation: 语言菜单中显示的区域名称。

doc.e748835e40860fd7.source:
The key is usually `textures`.
Base64 encoded JSON value of the texture index.
doc.e748835e40860fd7.translation:
键通常为 `textures`。
纹理索引的 Base64 编码 JSON 值。

doc.de63115530893001.source: Duration of the effect in ticks. Infinite is represented by `-1`.
doc.de63115530893001.translation: 效果的时间（单位为刻）。无限表示为 `-1`。

doc.68dfeed3a647eb0b.source: Whether particles are semi-transparent. (like with a Beacon)
doc.68dfeed3a647eb0b.translation: 粒子是否为半透明。（类似于信标）

doc.edfc34f869035a6c.source: Whether the effect icon should be shown.

doc.5b219cdcc1a5860c.source: A lower amplifier effect of the same type.
doc.5b219cdcc1a5860c.translation: 同类型的较低放大效果。

doc.a574f5017d12354e.source: Level I having value 0. Defaults to 0.
doc.a574f5017d12354e.translation: 值为 0 的 I 级。默认为 0。

doc.67ce5e8c0f1452a7.source: Whether the effect appears as a HUD icon in addition to in the inventory GUI (same behavior as beacons when `true`). Defaults to `false`.
doc.67ce5e8c0f1452a7.translation: 效果是否除了在物品栏 GUI 中外还作为 HUD 图标显示（与 `true` 时的信标行为相同）。默认为 `false`。

doc.b1b3c82522bc4d70.source: Whether the effect appears in the inventory GUI. Defaults to `true`
doc.b1b3c82522bc4d70.translation: 效果是否在物品栏 GUI 中显示。默认为 `true`

doc.703b3f44ac2587b8.source: Shown only to players with chat filtering enabled.
doc.703b3f44ac2587b8.translation: 仅向启用了聊天过滤的玩家显示。

doc.bcb49247a3c3ca81.source: offset from the entity's feet to the source position
doc.bcb49247a3c3ca81.translation: 从实体脚部到源位置的偏移量

doc.55a5afb81446d85a.source: Distance in blocks to the source

doc.832652926ddddf05.source: UUID of the source entity of the event, if one exists
doc.832652926ddddf05.translation: 如果存在，事件源实体的 UUID

doc.c2026172a4a5341b.source: If present, ticks before this memory is automatically removed.
doc.c2026172a4a5341b.translation: 如果存在，表示此记忆自动移除前的刻数。

doc.17310faeb1d52860.source: Ticks before the armadillo or camel can randomly look around again.
doc.17310faeb1d52860.translation: 犰狳或骆驼可以再次随机环顾前的刻数。

doc.8fb34836ad7b292e.source: Whether the villager has detected an iron golem recently.
doc.8fb34836ad7b292e.translation: 村民最近是否检测到铁傀儡。

doc.966f92ef33e32ad3.source: Whether the axolotl is in a hunting cooldown.
doc.966f92ef33e32ad3.translation: 美西螈是否处于狩猎冷却中。

doc.a7b835e3fcd06908.source:
Whether the piglin just hunted recently.
Set after hunting or spawning in a bastion remnant.
doc.a7b835e3fcd06908.translation:
猪灵最近是否刚完成狩猎。
在堡垒遗迹中狩猎或生成后设置。

doc.4c257911f8d7d98e.source: Whether the warden is currently emerging from the ground.
doc.4c257911f8d7d98e.translation: 监守者当前是否正在从地面emerge。

doc.5058a8d49ec7e351.source: Whether the frog is currently in water.

doc.94fcf7377bdeb5ce.source: Whether the mob is currently panicking.
doc.94fcf7377bdeb5ce.translation: 生物当前是否处于恐慌状态。

doc.e30d100884e20dbd.source: Whether the warden or sniffer is currently sniffing.
doc.e30d100884e20dbd.translation: 监守者或嗅探兽当前是否正在嗅探。

doc.03b5b82be58810be.source: Whether the mob is currently tempted by a player.
doc.03b5b82be58810be.translation: 生物当前是否被玩家诱惑。

doc.7d8b3049b90f0c50.source: Ticks before the allay goes to pick up an item again.
doc.7d8b3049b90f0c50.translation: 悦灵再次去拾取物品前的刻数。

doc.5d4ede25d807227b.source: Position of the villager's job site.

doc.c916b1af0d12045c.source: The gametime tick that the villager last slept in a bed.
doc.c916b1af0d12045c.translation: 村民上次在床上睡觉的游戏时间刻。

doc.f32b6b761a207030.source: The gametime tick that the villager last woke up from a bed.
doc.f32b6b761a207030.translation: 村民上次从床上醒来的游戏时间刻。

doc.1518d9fc27122e26.source: The gametime tick that the villager last worked at their job site.
doc.1518d9fc27122e26.translation: 村民上次在工作地点工作的游戏时间刻。

doc.f4552193ee45fe1f.source: The position and dimension of the note block that the allay likes.
doc.f4552193ee45fe1f.translation: 悦灵喜欢的音符盒的位置和维度。

doc.ab394c3b7fecc213.source: Ticks before the allay stops putting items at the liked note block.
doc.ab394c3b7fecc213.translation: 悦灵停止在喜欢的音符盒处放置物品前的刻数。

doc.66801a00a18adcdb.source: The UUID of the player entity that the allay likes.
doc.66801a00a18adcdb.translation: 悦灵喜欢的玩家实体的UUID。

doc.1cb7daa339fb2b4e.source: Ticks before the goat can long jump again.
doc.1cb7daa339fb2b4e.translation: 山羊可以再次进行长跳前的刻数。

doc.bb5b15a1cdfac4e7.source: Position of the villager's meeting point.

doc.ace5280e9893f66e.source: UUID of the owner of the projectile, if one exists
doc.ace5280e9893f66e.translation: 弹射物所有者的UUID，如果存在的话

doc.587523199a9dadb2.source: Range in blocks where vibrations can be detected
doc.587523199a9dadb2.translation: 可以检测到震动的方块范围

doc.ad06ddb2aee85c37.source: Event that is being received, if any
doc.ad06ddb2aee85c37.translation: 正在接收的事件，如果有的话

doc.475f84bcf86b91b0.source: Distance in blocks to the event that is being received
doc.475f84bcf86b91b0.translation: 到正在接收的事件的方块距离

doc.3cf512c3e1ac3d89.source: Delay in ticks until the event reaches this listener
doc.3cf512c3e1ac3d89.translation: 直到事件到达此监听器的刻数延迟

doc.fe24be0efbbeaf10.source: Coordinates of the location in [x, y, z]

doc.8e4100a81f41075e.source:
Whether the piglin cannot admire an item.
Set when converting, when attacked, or when admiring an item.
doc.8e4100a81f41075e.translation:
猪灵是否无法欣赏物品。
在转换、受到攻击或欣赏物品时设置。

doc.af2282d0d37448f5.source: Whether the piglin is currently admiring an item.
doc.af2282d0d37448f5.translation: 猪灵当前是否正在欣赏物品。

doc.047b212fd18f4a49.source: The target of the piglin or piglin brute.
doc.047b212fd18f4a49.translation: 猪灵或猪灵强壮者的目标。

doc.05b4547d0d37290f.source: If present, the breeze will not long jump or slide. Set after performing a long jump.
doc.05b4547d0d37290f.translation: 如果存在，旋风人将不会进行长跳或滑动。在执行长跳后设置。

doc.25527042ebe6bda3.source: If present, the breeze will not long jump or shoot a wind charge when stuck.
doc.25527042ebe6bda3.translation: 如果存在，旋风人在卡住时将不会进行长跳或发射风力弹。

doc.e37f696594b66790.source: The block position that the breeze is jumping towards.
doc.e37f696594b66790.translation: 旋风人正在跳向的方块位置。

doc.76d3bd6be9ad3303.source: If present, the breeze is in water.
doc.76d3bd6be9ad3303.translation: 如果存在，旋风人处于水中。

doc.736adbf1b96f1832.source: If present, the breeze is able to shoot a wind charge, and will not long jump or slide.
doc.736adbf1b96f1832.translation: 如果存在，旋风人能够发射风力弹，且不会进行长跳或滑动。

doc.97c79e4b55d8229d.source: If present, the breeze will not shoot a wind charge. Set when starting to shoot.
doc.97c79e4b55d8229d.translation: 如果存在，旋风人将不会发射风力弹。在开始发射时设置。

doc.0be6a401f81a6f6c.source: If present, the breeze will not shoot a wind charge. Set after shooting
doc.0be6a401f81a6f6c.translation: 如果存在，旋风人将不会发射风力弹。在发射后设置。

doc.690529aff7c4fd8d.source: If present, the breeze will not shoot a wind charge.
doc.690529aff7c4fd8d.translation: 如果存在，旋风人将不会发射风力弹。

doc.91204ca13c5085cc.source: Whether the armadillo has detected danger recently.
doc.91204ca13c5085cc.translation: 犰狳最近是否检测到危险。

doc.1298013559e0d88e.source: If present, the warden will not dig down.
doc.1298013559e0d88e.translation: 如果存在，监守者将不会向下挖掘。

doc.d46148ff9e3dd7e1.source:
Whether the language reads right to left.
Defaults to `false`.
doc.d46148ff9e3dd7e1.translation:
语言是否从右到左阅读。
默认为 `false`。

doc.c57acd813c0f30ef.source: The key matches language JSON file name (e.g. `en_us`).
doc.c57acd813c0f30ef.translation: 键名与语言 JSON 文件名匹配（例如 `en_us`）。

doc.3371ea0b3be89bdb.source: Adds all of the modifiers' amounts to the current value of the attribute.
doc.3371ea0b3be89bdb.translation: 将所有修正量的数值加到属性的当前值上。

doc.d4933787c1cbe711.source:
Multiplies the current value of the attribute by `(1 + x)`,
where `x` is the sum of the modifiers' amounts.
doc.d4933787c1cbe711.translation:
将属性的当前值乘以 `(1 + x)`，
其中 `x` 是所有修正量的总和。

doc.363e22ae8a629c72.source:
For every modifier, multiplies the current value of the attribute by `(1 + x)`,
where `x` is the amount of the particular modifier.
doc.363e22ae8a629c72.translation:
对于每个修正量，将属性的当前值乘以 `(1 + x)`，
其中 `x` 是该特定修正量的数值。

doc.97f003e3d189282c.source: aka. `add_value`. Adds all of the modifiers' amounts to the current value of the attribute.
doc.97f003e3d189282c.translation: 即 `add_value`。将所有修正量的数值加到属性的当前值上。

doc.369e763186f256ad.source:
aka. `add_multiplied_base`. Multiplies the current value of the attribute by (1 + x),
where x is the sum of the modifiers' amounts.
doc.369e763186f256ad.translation:
即 `add_multiplied_base`。将属性的当前值乘以 (1 + x)，
其中 x 是所有修正量的总和。

doc.ed91a006257b769e.source:
aka. `add_multiplied_total`. For every modifier, multiplies the current value of the attribute by (1 + x),
where x is the amount of the particular modifier.
Functions the same as Operation 1 if there is only a single modifier with operation 1 or 2.
However, for multiple modifiers it will multiply the modifiers rather than adding them
doc.ed91a006257b769e.translation:
即 `add_multiplied_total`。对于每个修正量，将属性的当前值乘以 (1 + x)，
其中 x 是该特定修正量的数值。
如果只有一个具有操作 1 或 2 的修正量，其功能与操作 1 相同。
但是对于多个修正量，它将相乘而非相加。

doc.e9ad992bb1bb3b53.source: UUID of the owner. Used to update the other tags when the chunk loads or the holder logs in, in case the owner's name has changed.
doc.e9ad992bb1bb3b53.translation: 所有者的 UUID。用于在区块加载或持有者登录时，在所有者名称更改的情况下更新其他标签。

doc.cc65f9d269a0e2d4.source: Resolved textures hosted on the minecraft CDN.
doc.cc65f9d269a0e2d4.translation: 在 Minecraft CDN 上解析的纹理。

doc.42e987ddc521051f.source:
Username of a player profile.
If `id` doesn't exist, this field is used to fetch the current skin of the profile.
doc.42e987ddc521051f.translation:
玩家资料的用户名。
如果 `id` 不存在，则使用此字段获取资料当前的皮肤。

doc.a001ca881ef62f0b.source:
UUID of the player profile.
If `name` doesn't exist, this field is used to fetch the current skin of the profile.
doc.a001ca881ef62f0b.translation:
玩家资料的 UUID。
如果 `name` 不存在，则使用此字段获取资料当前的皮肤。

doc.f0b8202bc1a33492.source:
Elytra texture override.
If this texture is not present either as override or in player profile, the cape texture is used.
If the cape texture is also not present, the default elytra texture is used.
doc.f0b8202bc1a33492.translation:
鞘翅纹理覆盖。
如果该纹理既不是作为覆盖存在，也不在玩家资料中，则使用披风纹理。
如果披风纹理也不存在，则使用默认的鞘翅纹理。

doc.865e21ea2204ca7b.source: Base64 encoded JSON value of the texture index.
doc.865e21ea2204ca7b.translation: 纹理索引的 Base64 编码 JSON 值。

doc.4b2ceea7e87cd806.source: Verifies the hash of the resulting texture.
doc.4b2ceea7e87cd806.translation: 验证生成的纹理的哈希值。

doc.cd7ba856e2447a97.source:
Overrides the shadow properties of the text.
If specified as 0, the shadow will never be displayed.
doc.cd7ba856e2447a97.translation:
覆盖文本的阴影属性。
如果指定为 0，则永远不显示阴影。

doc.0b6c7874d9ae9992.source: The dye color of the pattern.

doc.04bddefc5cbd362a.source: Ticks until the axolotl stops playing dead.
doc.04bddefc5cbd362a.translation: 美西螈停止装死的刻数。

doc.23923606a41e0d9e.source: Position of a potential job site of the villager.
doc.23923606a41e0d9e.translation: 村民潜在工作地点的位置。

doc.7a501ab822a3b43c.source: Ticks before the goat can ram again.
doc.7a501ab822a3b43c.translation: 山羊可以再次冲撞前的刻数。

doc.845e2e8c71391764.source: Whether the warden has recently noticed a projectile vibration.
doc.845e2e8c71391764.translation: 监守者最近是否注意到弹射物震动。

doc.bf99c5f9006fcc5e.source: If present, the warden doesn't roar.
doc.bf99c5f9006fcc5e.translation: 若存在，监守者不会咆哮。

doc.1aeaff16e8f190c5.source: If present, the warden or sniffer will not sniff.
doc.1aeaff16e8f190c5.translation: 若存在，监守者或嗅探兽将不会嗅探。

doc.405ec5d018198c28.source: Last 20 block positions that the sniffer has dug up. The sniffer will not dig in these positions.
doc.405ec5d018198c28.translation: 嗅探兽挖掘过的最后20个方块位置。嗅探兽不会在这些位置挖掘。

doc.d48f68f43b2fc7a4.source: If present, the warden will not use the sonic boom attack.
doc.d48f68f43b2fc7a4.translation: 若存在，监守者将不会使用音爆攻击。

doc.1f5eebe16c8e7071.source: If present, the warden's sonic boom animation will not spawn particles and play sounds.
doc.1f5eebe16c8e7071.translation: 若存在，监守者的音爆动画将不会生成粒子并播放声音。

doc.9469b25689d45529.source: If present, will delay the warden's sonic boom animation.
doc.9469b25689d45529.translation: 若存在，将延迟监守者的音爆动画。

doc.391a79fc0e5f3cc0.source: Ticks before the mob can be tempted again.
doc.391a79fc0e5f3cc0.translation: 生物可以再次被诱导前的刻数。

doc.4f90a3ac46054422.source: If present, the warden will not react to being pushed by another mob. Set to 20 when touched.
doc.4f90a3ac46054422.translation: 若存在，监守者不会对被其他生物推动做出反应。被触碰时设为20。

doc.631fe82cfefb7cdb.source: Whether the piglin is being universally angered. Only used when the `universalAnger` gamerule is enabled.
doc.631fe82cfefb7cdb.translation: 猪灵是否处于普遍愤怒状态。仅在启用 `universalAnger` 游戏规则时使用。

doc.93d363002f56f2e1.source: A list of container positions that the copper golem has visited and failed to interact with.
doc.93d363002f56f2e1.translation: 铜傀儡访问过且未能与之交互的容器位置列表。

doc.d60f45e64058da39.source: If present, the warden will not react to vibrations. Set to 40 when receiving a vibration.
doc.d60f45e64058da39.translation: 若存在，监守者不会对震动做出反应。接收到震动时设为40。

doc.1e7bd42d331362df.source: A list of container positions that the copper golem has visited, whether successful or not.
doc.1e7bd42d331362df.translation: 铜傀儡访问过的容器位置列表，无论是否成功。

doc.0129b94549050ea0.source:
Multiplier of initial velocity.
Defaults to 1.0
doc.0129b94549050ea0.translation:
初始速度乘数。
默认为1.0

doc.c8d59ca7136bc0fd.source: Scales the particle size and its burst impulse.
doc.c8d59ca7136bc0fd.translation: 缩放粒子大小及其爆发冲量。

doc.7bd2d7b10d1a00a9.source: Left of upside-down Diagonal (Per bend inverted)

doc.dd4c261951c3a13b.source: Right of Diagonal (Per bend sinister inverted)
doc.dd4c261951c3a13b.translation: 左下三角 (Per bend sinister inverted)

doc.331f20f76b45438b.source: Number of levels from the pyramid.

doc.7d78ee6636748358.translation:
未知
0 代表普通方块实体

doc.2d983e7f8ff59f9f.source:
* 0: left brewing slot
* 1: middle brewing slot
* 2: right brewing slot
* 3: ingredient slot
* 4: fuel slot
doc.2d983e7f8ff59f9f.translation:
* 0: 左侧酿造槽位
* 1: 中间酿造槽位
* 2: 右侧酿造槽位
* 3: 材料槽位
* 4: 燃料槽位

doc.7ea3018920bb03de.source: Number of ticks until the brewing is complete.

doc.85e9758de5894321.source: Amount of fuel the brewing stand has left.

doc.cf1cd2c0905d3d7b.source: The total amount of time the current brewing process will take. Defaults to `400`.
doc.cf1cd2c0905d3d7b.translation: 当前酿造过程所需的总时间。默认为 `400`。

doc.42450512ab9f614e.source: The amount of fuel that was added in the last refuel. Defaults to `20`.
doc.42450512ab9f614e.translation: 上次补充的燃料量。默认为 `20`。

doc.9b51be538e6f182d.source: Used to speed up or slow down the next brewing process. Defaults to `1`.
doc.9b51be538e6f182d.translation: 用于加速或减慢下一个酿造过程。默认为 `1`。

doc.e1ac372fdf97541c.source: Loot table that will decide the brushed loot.
doc.e1ac372fdf97541c.translation: 决定刷出的战利品的战利品表。

doc.e1e6fd51e196d2e4.source: Item that was rolled from the loot table, which is currently peeking out.
doc.e1e6fd51e196d2e4.translation: 从战利品表中抽取的、当前露出的物品。

doc.e19c5dc026caf176.source:
Direction of the block that was interacted with.
Write-only, is not saved by the game.
doc.e19c5dc026caf176.translation:
与交互的方块方向。
仅写入，游戏不会保存。

doc.2c9cb35d70923635.source:
Ticks each item has been cooking.
Index is according to item slot.
doc.2c9cb35d70923635.translation:
每个物品已烹饪的刻数。
索引对应物品槽位。

doc.8942a90b0c2b690e.source:
Ticks each item still has to cook.
Index is according to item slot.
doc.8942a90b0c2b690e.translation:
每个物品剩余需要烹饪的刻数。
索引对应物品槽位。

doc.3c79401acb9006a4.source: Success count of the last command.
doc.3c79401acb9006a4.translation: 上一个命令的成功次数。

doc.1307923eb04bd4f3.source: Whether to record the tick of the latest command execution.
doc.1307923eb04bd4f3.translation: 是否记录最新命令执行的刻。

doc.d98655a20c10ad9e.source: Tick of the latest command execution.

doc.1a37c54aac4f8a5d.source: Whether it is powered by redstone.

doc.f4451d6cfb791b98.source:
Whether the previous command block was successful when the command block was executed.
This is always true for non-conditional command blocks.
doc.f4451d6cfb791b98.translation:
当命令方块执行时，前一个命令方块是否成功。

doc.6d85347ed97d8322.translation: 从生物身上剪下该物品时播放的声音事件。

doc.de77c99c946d0df5.translation:
被视为有效的到目标的最小距离。

Maximum distance to the target to be considered valid.

doc.9495fbbf0ec86d93.translation:
被视为有效的到目标的最大距离。

doc.37047aaef979f061.source:
Minimum distance from the creative mode attacker to the target to be considered valid.

doc.37047aaef979f061.translation:
被视为有效的从创造模式攻击者到目标的最小距离。

doc.8d009012bca3e942.source:
Maximum distance from the creative mode attacker to the target to be considered valid.
Defaults to 5.0
doc.8d009012bca3e942.translation:
被视为有效的从创造模式攻击者到目标的最大距离。
默认为 5.0

doc.6b648ce59a907e3a.source:
The margin applied to the target bounding box when checking for valid hitbox collision.
Defaults to 0.3
doc.6b648ce59a907e3a.translation:
检查有效碰撞箱碰撞时应用于目标包围盒的边距。
默认为 0.3

doc.f08b52c3e6faaba8.source: The multiplier applied to `min_reach` and `max_reach` when the user is a mob.
doc.f08b52c3e6faaba8.translation: 当用户为生物时，应用于 `min_reach` 和 `max_reach` 的乘数。

doc.c72e4779b9bea5b7.source: The text contents to show for this attribute modifer entry.
doc.c72e4779b9bea5b7.translation: 此属性修改条目显示的文本内容。

doc.c83e58304bc8bf6b.source: Shows the calculated attribute modifier values on the tooltip.
doc.c83e58304bc8bf6b.translation: 在工具提示上显示计算出的属性修改值。

doc.49b4b7b4461feec1.source: Does not show the attribute modifier entry in tooltips.
doc.49b4b7b4461feec1.translation: 不在工具提示中显示属性修改条目。

doc.02cb67d4aabfa927.source: Replaces the shown attribute modifier text.
doc.02cb67d4aabfa927.translation: 替换显示的属性修改文本。

doc.af5d965112b61e33.source: Used when equipping and unequipping the item to identify which modifier to add or remove from the entity.
doc.af5d965112b61e33.translation: 在装备和卸下物品时用于识别从实体中添加或移除哪个修改。

doc.46db15c6c2e1b33d.source: Slot or slot type the item must be in for the modifier to take effect. Defaults to `any`.
doc.46db15c6c2e1b33d.translation: 修改生效时物品必须所在的槽位或槽位类型。默认为 `any`。

doc.0101fb485cf67218.source: Controls how this modifier is shown in the item tooltip.
doc.0101fb485cf67218.translation: 控制此修改在物品工具提示中的显示方式。

doc.b1d63cc2f943d1ba.source:
Number of seconds that right-click must be held before successfully blocking attacks.
Defaults to `0`.
doc.b1d63cc2f943d1ba.translation:
成功阻挡攻击前必须按住右键的秒数。
默认为 `0`。

doc.6a8d3a65487ce31d.source:
Multiplier applied to the number of seconds that the item will be on cooldown for when attacked by a disabling attack (`disable_blocking_for_seconds` on the `weapon` component).
Defaults to `1`.
If `0`, this item can never be disabled by attacks.
doc.6a8d3a65487ce31d.translation:
当受到禁用攻击时，物品进入禁用冷却状态的秒数乘数（`weapon` 组件上的 `disable_blocking_for_seconds`）。
默认为 `1`。
如果 `0`，则此物品永远不会被攻击禁用。

doc.50e590ed48614681.source:
Controls how much damage should be blocked in a given attack. If not specified, all damage is blocked.
Each entry in the list contributes an amount of damage to be blocked, optionally filtered by a damage type.
Each entry adds to blocked damage, determined by `clamp(base + factor * dealt_damage, 0, dealt_damage)`.
The final damage applied in the attack to the entity is determined by `dealt_damage - clamp(blocked_damage, 0, dealt_damage)`.
doc.50e590ed48614681.translation:
控制在给定攻击中应阻挡多少伤害。如果未指定，则阻挡所有伤害。
列表中的每项都贡献要阻挡的伤害量，可按伤害类型过滤。
每项都会增加被阻挡的伤害，由 `clamp(base + factor * dealt_damage, 0, dealt_damage)` 决定。
攻击对实体造成的最终伤害由 `dealt_damage - clamp(blocked_damage, 0, dealt_damage)` 决定。

doc.bf33ef498797e6ff.source:
Controls how much damage should be applied to the item from a given attack.
If not specified, a point of durability is removed for every point of damage dealt.
The final damage applied to the item is determined by `floor(base + factor * dealt_damage)`.
The final value may be negative, causing the item to be repaired.
doc.bf33ef498797e6ff.translation:
控制从给定攻击中应对物品造成的伤害量。
如果未指定，每点伤害都会移除一个耐久度点。
对物品造成的最终伤害由 `floor(base + factor * dealt_damage)` 决定。
最终值可能为负数，导致物品被修复。

doc.5b0aed6aea1ff96c.source: Sound played when an attack is successfully blocked.
doc.5b0aed6aea1ff96c.translation: 成功阻挡攻击时播放的声音。

doc.b99bad676875e61b.source: Sound played when the item goes on its disabled cooldown due to an attack.

doc.3667937bc9e4bb9b.translation: 燃料在被消耗前可酿造的总配方数量。

doc.78ae9a3787fac4ff.translation: 实体是否应发出任何声音。

doc.0fb12dc1aeef4e8d.translation: 实体是否应受重力影响。

doc.186e7782bf3c375d.translation: 实体是否不应自然消失。

doc.861d6c347a93bb2e.translation: 对于美西螈，转换为内存模块 `has_hunting_cooldown` 的过期时间。

doc.0b1adb528851f4c1.source: Turns into the `Variant` entity tag for tropical fish.
doc.0b1adb528851f4c1.translation: 对于热带鱼，转换为 `Variant` 实体标签。

doc.2fd01d2c7d8f8657.source: The age for axolotl and tadpole.

doc.380293fc48541fb7.translation: 美西螈和蝌蚪的年龄锁定状态。

doc.1aa698132e19559e.source: The age locked state for sulfur cube.
doc.1aa698132e19559e.translation: 硫方怪的年龄锁定状态。

doc.f4c3985939f68d03.source: Time taken for a player to consume the item. Defaults to 1.6.
doc.f4c3985939f68d03.translation: 玩家消耗该物品所需的时间。默认为 1.6。

doc.252824f676524a14.source: View model/arms animation used during consumption of the item. Defaults to `eat`.
doc.252824f676524a14.translation: 消耗该物品时使用的视角模型/手臂动画。默认为 `eat`。

doc.c3415c0a110ff78e.source: Whether the `item` particle is emitted while consuming the item. Defaults to `true`.
doc.c3415c0a110ff78e.translation: 消耗该物品时是否发射 `item` 粒子。默认为 `true`。

doc.cdc889614be012dd.source: Side effects which take place after consuming the item.
doc.cdc889614be012dd.translation: 消耗该物品后发生的副作用。

doc.812329979c695d94.source: Item that is displayed to players when they are in range of the vault.
doc.812329979c695d94.translation: 玩家进入宝库范围时显示的物品。

doc.1315deace7e4bab7.source:
When a player is in range of the vault, the same display item will be shown to all players.
This is also used for the items that are being ejected from the vault.
doc.1315deace7e4bab7.translation:
当玩家进入宝库范围时，所有玩家都将看到相同的显示物品。
此项也用于从宝库中弹出的物品。

doc.4f3b93e42021e736.source: The slot ID of the container.

doc.939731b5bfc57952.source: The item stack in this container slot.
doc.939731b5bfc57952.translation: 此容器槽位中的物品堆叠。

doc.85ee55cda0fdd521.source: Shown to players with the profanity filter enabled on Realms.
doc.85ee55cda0fdd521.translation: 在启用了 Realms 脏话过滤功能的玩家面前显示。

doc.403e6c0687d8ced5.source:
Sound played during and on completion of item consumption. \
If not specified, the default eating sound will be played.
doc.403e6c0687d8ced5.translation:
消耗物品期间及完成后播放的声音。 \
如果未指定，将播放默认的进食声音。

doc.9b48eee5ff749023.source: Sound played during and on completion of item consumption.
doc.9b48eee5ff749023.translation: 消耗物品期间及完成后播放的声音。

doc.614b1a8f9faa65c8.source:
Sound event to play when the item is equipped. \
If not specified, the default armor equip sound will be played.
doc.614b1a8f9faa65c8.translation:
装备物品时播放的声音事件。 \
如果未指定，将播放默认的护甲装备声音。

doc.ae89941ad7d9a676.source:
An optional damage type to filter this reduction by.
If not specified, any damage type is accepted for this reduction.
doc.ae89941ad7d9a676.translation:
用于过滤此减伤的可选伤害类型。
如果未指定，则接受任何伤害类型。

doc.49b0cdfd1b358d06.source: Constant amount of damage to be blocked.

doc.341dc6f7d36a7f36.source: Fraction of the dealt damage that should be blocked.

doc.5d398e288b8d12f9.source: Maximum angle between facing direction and incoming attack direction for the blocking to be effective
doc.5d398e288b8d12f9.translation: 拦截生效时，面对方向与 incoming 攻击方向之间的最大角度

doc.0209d1641446a9df.source:
The damage types which the item is resistant to when in entity form.
Additionally, this also affects whether the equipped item will be damaged when the wearer is hurt by a specified damage type.
doc.0209d1641446a9df.translation:
当物品以实体形式存在时，其具有抗性的伤害类型。
此外，这还会影响当佩戴者受到指定伤害类型伤害时，所装备的物品是否会受损。

doc.43b955d3ecbb5754.source: Effects applied when the item protects the holder.
doc.43b955d3ecbb5754.translation: 当物品保护持有者时应用的效果。

doc.1b9856f7ba5a6dea.source:
Color of the armor.
Calculated as `RED << 16 | GREEN << 8 | BLUE`. Each of these fields must be between 0 and 255, inclusive.
doc.1b9856f7ba5a6dea.translation:
护甲颜色。
计算方式为 `RED << 16 | GREEN << 8 | BLUE`。每个字段必须在 0 到 255 之间（包含边界）。

doc.671def4e0608c907.source:
The equipment model to use when equipped.
Falls back to rendering as the item itself when in the head slot (or no rendering if not applicable).
doc.671def4e0608c907.translation:
装备时使用的装备模型。
当在头部槽位时（或不适用时），将回退为渲染为物品本身。

doc.98e8d5c64c66a223.source: The overlay texture that should render in first person when equipped.
doc.98e8d5c64c66a223.translation: 装备时应在第一人称中渲染的覆盖层纹理。

doc.18dd6ee5f734597b.source: Limits which entities can equip this item.
doc.18dd6ee5f734597b.translation: 限制哪些实体可以装备此物品。

doc.efc3a5e6658cd5d6.source: Whether the item can be equipped by using a dispenser. Defaults to `true`.
doc.efc3a5e6658cd5d6.translation: 是否可以使用发射器装备此物品。默认为 `true`。

doc.3bcbaf1119332b43.source: Whether the item can be equipped by right-clicking. Defaults to `true`.
doc.3bcbaf1119332b43.translation: 是否可以通过右键点击装备此物品。默认为 `true`。

doc.1ec8f717a712b0c2.source: Whether the item will be damaged when the wearer is damaged. Defaults to `true`.
doc.1ec8f717a712b0c2.translation: 当佩戴者受到伤害时，物品是否会受损。默认为 `true`。

doc.48cea0b1a2210a05.source:
Whether players can equip this item onto a target mob by right-clicking it (as long as this item can be equipped on the target at all).
The item will not be equipped if the target already has an item in the relevant slot.
Defaults to `false`.
doc.48cea0b1a2210a05.translation:
玩家是否可以通过右键点击目标生物将其装备到目标身上（前提是该物品可以装备到目标身上）。
如果目标在相关槽位中已有物品，则不会装备该物品。
默认为 `false`。

doc.809cfef5067bbc55.source:
Whether players can use shears to remove this item from a mob by right-clicking it (as long as other shearing conditions are satisfied).
Defaults to `false`.
doc.809cfef5067bbc55.translation:
玩家是否可以通过右键点击生物并使用剪刀来移除此物品（前提是满足其他剪毛条件）。
默认为 `false`。

doc.16c12437bcb7837d.source:
Colors of the initial particles of the explosion, randomly selected from.
Calculated as `RED << 16 | GREEN << 8 | BLUE`. Each of these fields must be between 0 and 255, inclusive.
doc.16c12437bcb7837d.translation:
爆炸初始粒子的颜色，从随机选择中选取。
计算方式为 `RED << 16 | GREEN << 8 | BLUE`。每个字段必须在 0 到 255 之间（包含边界）。

doc.494afe6490e603c9.source: Colors of the fading particles of the explosion

doc.b4e0793010a41d2c.source: Added to a firework star via Diamond.
doc.b4e0793010a41d2c.translation: 通过钻石添加到烟花星。

doc.04b6b5e41af99ced.source: Added to a firework star via Glowstone Dust.
doc.04b6b5e41af99ced.translation: 通过荧石粉添加到烟花星。

doc.b27515a4d87fb270.source: Food points/haunches restored when eaten (capped to 20.0).
doc.b27515a4d87fb270.translation: 食用时恢复的食物点数/肉块（上限为 20.0）。

doc.5316aea3d6a0b538.source: Exact value added to the player's saturation level, capped at whatever the [new] food points value is.
doc.5316aea3d6a0b538.translation: 添加到玩家饱和度的精确值，上限为[新]食物点数的值。

doc.7386ab9af63ff0d3.source: Whether the item can be eaten when the player's food points/haunches are full. Defaults to `false`
doc.7386ab9af63ff0d3.translation: 玩家食物点数/肉块已满时是否可以食用此物品。默认为 `false`

doc.b9150983d08940bd.source: Seconds it takes to eat the item. Defaults to `1.6`
doc.b9150983d08940bd.translation: 食用此物品所需秒数。默认为 `1.6`

doc.4818e97c260503dc.source: Works similarly to a milk bucket.

doc.8db01dae46050747.source: Chance for the effect to be applied. Defaults to 1.
doc.8db01dae46050747.translation: 效果生效的概率。默认为 1。

doc.450f7529e66f8598.source: Minimum amount of damage dealt by the attack before this item damage is applied to the item.
doc.450f7529e66f8598.translation: 在此物品伤害应用到物品之前，攻击造成的最小伤害量。

doc.3f2aff45a3655d49.source: Constant amount of damage applied to the item, if `threshold` is passed.
doc.3f2aff45a3655d49.translation: 如果 `threshold` 为真，则应用到物品上的固定伤害量。

doc.01ead9cfee2c5fcf.source: Fraction of the dealt damage that should be applied to the item, if `threshold` is passed.
doc.01ead9cfee2c5fcf.translation: 如果 `threshold` 为真，则应用到物品上的伤害比例。

doc.a2881a072864e7c8.source:
The time in ticks required for charging.
Defaults to 0
doc.a2881a072864e7c8.translation:
充能所需的时间（单位：刻）。
默认为 0

doc.8b095556a32f5347.source:
The cooldown in ticks after hitting, and loosing contact with an entity before being able to hit it again
Defaults to 10
doc.8b095556a32f5347.translation:
击中并与实体失去接触后，再次击中前的冷却时间（单位：刻）。
默认为 10

doc.425e90e9bbe6c635.source:
The distance the item moves out of hand during animation.
Defaults to 0.0
doc.425e90e9bbe6c635.translation:
动画期间物品离开手中的距离。
默认为 0.0

doc.94273df929b1755b.source:
The multiplier for the final damage from the relative speed.
Defaults to 1.0
doc.94273df929b1755b.translation:
相对速度产生的最终伤害倍率。
默认为 1.0
